izzyondroid:de.bahnhoefe.deutschlands.ba.summary: Collect photos of railway stations for https://railway-stations.org
izzyondroid:de.bahnhoefe.deutschlands.ba.description:
Support the https://railway-stations.org OpenData project with the Railway stations photo app. Select a country and find a station without a photo. Over 20 countries are already in our database, more to be added step by step.
 Create an account under "My Data". You can contribute photos anonymously or with your nicknamen. If you like you can define a link to a social media profile of yours, e.g. Twitter, then we add it to all of your uploaded photos.

fdroid:ai.agent1c.hitomi.open.name: Open Hitomi
fdroid:ai.agent1c.hitomi.open.summary: Floating hedgehog assistant with local chat and browser tools
fdroid:ai.agent1c.hitomi.open.description:
Open Hitomi is a floating Android hedgehog assistant built around a local overlay interface.
 Current features include:
 a movable floating assistant overlay
 an in-app browser window for visible browsing and readback
 optional Termux integration for local shell-style commands
 local Solana wallet display tools
 local Ollama-compatible endpoint support
 optional xAI bring-your-own-key chat setup directly on the device
 For local setups, paste an Ollama endpoint such as http://127.0.0.1:11434 into the app. Open Hitomi will query the local server for installed models and use the first available one.
 If you prefer a hosted provider, you can also paste an xAI API key into the same field. Entered connection details stay stored locally on-device.
 Open Hitomi is intended to stay open, configurable, and suitable for local and self-hosted model routes first, with optional external providers second.

fdroid:app.xcy7e.contextium.name: Contextium
fdroid:app.xcy7e.contextium.description:
Contextium extends Android's native text-selection context menu with configurable actions for web searches.
 Select text in an app, choose Contextium , and open the selected text with one of your configured search URLs.
 Features 
 Add unlimited context-menu items.
 Configure a name, label, target URL, and URL parameter for each item.
 Reorder entries with drag and drop.
 Enable or disable entries individually.
 Export and import your configuration as a backup.
 How it works 
 Add a menu entry.
 Configure its name, URL, and parameter.
 Select text and choose Contextium.
 Choose an action to start the web search.
 The target website must support search terms passed as a URL parameter.
 For example, use https://www.google.com/search with the parameter q . Contextium then creates a URL such as https://www.google.com/search?q=foobar .

fdroid:com.bearinmind.launcher314.name: Launcher314
fdroid:com.bearinmind.launcher314.summary: Launcher with deep customization on a single screen
fdroid:com.bearinmind.launcher314.description:
I built this launcher for people to be able to easily access settings and customization all from one screen without having to go on a scavenger hunt to change something simple like row count or font size. I built this app to help me move to a more secure OS and thought oh, other people can use this too!
All your data is stored locally on the device, no exuberant permissions required such as internet connection or any data collection libraries (you can check with apps like TrackerControl or apps that will scan libraries for trackers).
One screen customization with preview windows to view your changes prior to even going into the launcher. Just like most launchers, icons, folders, and everything in the preview areas use bitmaps; while widgets are the only item using Live AndroidView. In the preview section you will see we have multiple ways to customize the launcher with columns & rows being independent of each-other in the Home Screen / App Drawer sections but only being bound by a universal icon size indicator making sure apps and text don't go out of bounds on each-other. In the app drawer you will also see a square check mark box next to the app drawer rows; this selection will switch you between the scroll mode & paged mode drawers and if you scroll further down to the scroll bar/ navigation drop down, you can customize both navigation indicators to you liking. Just above that you will notice an icon text dropdown where you can choose rom various fonts (most popular ones from other Launcher3 forks) & a way to adjust the text size.
Using this app is pretty straight forward and everything is contained in a few screens or less so you spend less time trying to figure out what a selection does or where to find a specific setting and instead just jump right in to customization and setting up the launcher; a feature I felt that most other launchers didn't do well.
Anyways who reads these descriptions anyways. Get in there buddy.
This app is free and open source software (FOSS) licensed under the GPL-3.0 License.

fdroid:com.calcitem.sanmill.name: Mill
fdroid:com.calcitem.sanmill.summary: A Mill Game which supports many rule variants, written in Flutter
fdroid:com.calcitem.sanmill.description:
A Classic Nine Men's Morris Experience
Rediscover the strategy of Nine Men's Morris, also known as the Mill game, with this digital version. Whether you are an experienced player or new to the game, this app offers a way to learn and enjoy this timeless board game.
Explore the game's features, which are designed for learning, practice, and customization. You can play the game your way, track your progress, and sharpen your skills with the help of an analysis engine.
KEY FEATURES
CLASSIC & VARIANT GAMEPLAY
Enjoy the experience of this traditional board game.
* Multiple Game Modes: Play Classic Nine Men’s Morris, along with variants like Twelve Men’s Morris, Lasker Morris, and the South African variant, Morabaraba.
* Capable AI Opponent: Challenge a computer opponent with 30 different difficulty levels, designed to provide a suitable match for players of various skill levels.
* Play with a Friend: Challenge a friend locally on a single device, or connect two devices over the same WLAN.
CUSTOMIZATION OPTIONS
Adjust the game to your preferences with a range of settings.
* Flexible Rules: You can enable or disable the "flying" endgame rule or toggle other common house rules to match the version you are familiar with.
* Visual Themes: Personalize your playing area with a selection of board backgrounds and piece designs.
* Custom Color Picker: Adjust the colors of the pieces and the board for better contrast and visibility.
* Sound Packs: Choose from different audio themes, for audio feedback during your game.
* Dark Mode & Haptics: A dark mode is available for comfortable play in low light. You can also adjust the haptic feedback for moves.
TRAINING & ANALYSIS SUITE
Improve your gameplay with some helpful tools.
* AI-Powered Positional Analysis: Use the AI to get feedback on your game. The engine provides positional evaluations to help you identify opportunities and understand mistakes.
* Unlimited Undo/Redo & Move List: You can take back moves to explore different scenarios. A clear, scrollable move list allows you to review the entire game sequence.
* Import, Export & Share Games: Share your matches using flexible import and export options. Copy games to and from your clipboard, or use the standard PGN file format. The app can directly open PGN files from your device. You can also share a quick visual by taking a screenshot and adding tactical annotations to the board.
TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
Monitor your improvement with the statistics module.
* Detailed Game Statistics: Keep a record of your games, including your win/loss/draw record against each AI difficulty level, to see your skills develop over time.
MULTILINGUAL SUPPORT
Experience the app in your preferred language.
* Supports 60+ Languages: The app is localized in 60+ languages, including English, Persian, German, Hungarian, Chinese, Portuguese, Arabic, French, Spanish, Turkish, and many more, ensuring accessibility for a global audience.
ACCESSIBILITY & QUALITY OF LIFE
* Built for Everyone: The app is designed with accessibility in mind, featuring clear screen-reader labels, large-print board options, and multilingual support.
* In-App Feedback: You can use the built-in feedback system to send suggestions or report issues to the development team.
STRATEGY TIPS FOR NEW PLAYERS
* Playing on the cross points because they offer more way mobility to the pieces.
* Corners are weak as the player can only move in fewer directions.
* Giving the piece space to move.
* Do not make mills straight away. Usually, the first player to make a mill in the placement phase will easily get blocked.
* Black has an advantage because it gets to place the last piece strategically.
* Double attacks - be aware that players can attack two points at the same time.
Whether you are revisiting a familiar game, looking for a strategic challenge, or discovering Morris games for the first time, this app offers an enjoyable experience with flexible rules, a capable AI, and a customizable interface.

fdroid:com.filestech.notes_tech.name: Notes Tech
fdroid:com.filestech.notes_tech.summary: Encrypted Markdown notes, 100% local. No Internet permission.
fdroid:com.filestech.notes_tech.description:
Notes Tech: 100% local Markdown note-taking, encrypted at rest. Written in Kotlin.
 Radical privacy 
• No INTERNET permission — verifiable with aapt dump permissions app.apk 
• No account, no telemetry, no tracker, no advertising
• SQLCipher AES-256 database, key sealed by the Android Keystore
• Multi-step panic mode: wipes keys, database and dictation model in seconds
• Optional app lock: a PIN, plus strong biometrics if you wish
 Per-folder vaults 
• Argon2id passphrase (m=64MB, t=3) or Keystore-bound PIN (Android 9+)
• AES-256-GCM per note, bound to its note (anti-swap)
• PIN auto-wipe after 5 failures
• Configurable auto-lock (5 min to never)
 On-device voice dictation 
• whisper.cpp built into the app; Whisper model imported manually
• SHA-256 verified at import and before loading
• Recordings deleted after transcription
 Editing 
• Notes open to be read (Markdown: headings, lists, links); “Edit” to write, autosave
• Long press to select notes, then archive, move, trash with Undo, pin, color or delete them at once
• An Archive for the notes you keep out of your lists
• A pastel colour per note in the lists (a vault note's only while its vault is open)
• [[Title]] backlinks with autocomplete + "notes linking here" panel
• Instant FTS5 search, find in note with highlighted matches, configurable sort
• Markdown export, one note or a ZIP (YAML frontmatter, Obsidian/Logseq compatible)
• Import of Markdown, text and ZIP files; share text or files from other apps
• Encrypted backup of your notes and vaults, restored without overwriting anything
 Five languages 
• English, French, German, Italian, Spanish — chosen in Settings
• Light / dark / system theme
• Privacy policy and terms in the five languages
 Permissions 
• Microphone: dictation only, asked when you turn it on
• Biometrics: app lock only, gives access to no data
 Open source Apache 2.0 
Full and verifiable source code on GitHub: gitubpatrice/notes_tech
For thinkers, therapists, students, researchers, writers and journalists who want to take sensitive or dense notes without them ever leaving their phone.

fdroid:com.io7m.exfilac.main.name: Exfilac
fdroid:com.io7m.exfilac.main.summary: Simple, reliable, automated S3 uploads for Android.
fdroid:com.io7m.exfilac.main.description:
The exfilac application is a simple application that aims to do one thing well:
Get data out of Android devices and into S3 buckets.
Features:
- The application can work with any S3-compatible storage provider. This
 includes Amazon AWS, Vultr Object Storage, IDrive®, and many other commercial
 offerings. Additionally, the application can work with self-hosted S3 storage
 solutions such as MinIO.
- The application can (recursively) upload the contents of any directory on an
 Android device to which it has been granted access. The set of directories
 is configurable.
- The application conserves precious bandwidth by avoiding uploading files that
 already exist on the remote storage. The cryptographic hashes of files are
 computed locally and files are only uploaded if the hashes of
 the files on the remote server do not match.
- The application can be configured to upload files on a timed schedule,
 and/or in response to various events occurring on the device such as a photo
 being taken, or the network becoming available.
- The application vigorously respects the privacy of users: The application
 contains no telemetry or analytics of any kind, and never collects any user data.
- Development of the application is performed in the open. The complete source code is made available under
 an extremely liberal ISC license, and development and bug tracking is handled
 in a public GitHub repository.
- The application rejects bug-prone Android programming practices and libraries
 and instead strives for correctness and stability using battle-hardened,
 well-tested components designed outside the traditional Android ecosystem.
- The application adopts a cautious development approach and does not pursue
 huge sets of complex features. The application attempts to adhere to the Unix
 philosophy and provide a simple, sharp tool that does one thing well.
- The application attempts to respect the intelligence of users. Technical
 details of many aspects of the system are clearly displayed onscreen, and
 important information is not hidden in the misguided pursuit of
 "user-friendliness".
- The application is comprehensively documented.

fdroid:com.nvllz.piggsy.name: Piggsy
fdroid:com.nvllz.piggsy.summary: Piggy banks for tracking your goals
fdroid:com.nvllz.piggsy.description:
Create multiple piggy banks for anything you’re saving for, whether it’s a trip, a new gadget, or a rainy-day fund. Each piggy bank can have its own currency, optional deadline, and short description.
The biggest advantage is that the app isn't tied to your actual balance. Think of it as a detailed visualization of your goals, not a friction making it difficult to transfer money between accounts when you need to change your plans. You just get to know how much money you can spend, everything else is up to you.
Add or subtract money as needed and keep a record of all your transactions. You can also add short notes to transactions to keep track of details. Automatic backups will keep your data safe behind the scenes.

fdroid:com.philkes.notallyx.name: NotallyX - Quick Notes/Tasks
fdroid:com.philkes.notallyx.summary: A simple and minimalistic open source notes app
fdroid:com.philkes.notallyx.description:
NotallyX is a minimalistic note taking app with a simple design and powerful features.
 Organization 
• Create rich text notes with support for bold, italics, mono space and more
• Create task lists and order them with subtasks
• Set reminders with notifications for important notes
• Complement your notes with any type of file such as pictures, PDFs, etc.
• Sort notes by title, last modified date, creation date
• Display the notes either in a List or Grid
• Color, pin and label your notes for quick organisation
• Add clickable links to notes with support for phone numbers, email addresses and web urls
• Actions to quickly remove checked tasks
• Undo/Redo actions
• Extensive preferences to adjust views to your liking
• Quickly share notes by text
• Lock your notes via Biometric/PIN
• Configurable auto-backups
• Create audio notes
• Adaptive android app icon
• Support for Lollipop devices and up
 Convenience 
• Dark mode
• Completely free (+ no Ads!)
• Adjustable text size
• Auto save and auto-backups (optionally password-protected)
• Add notes and lists to your home screen with widgets
• Import from other Notes apps such as Evernote, Google Keep or plain text files
 Privacy 
There are no ads, trackers or analytics of any kind. All your notes are stored completely on and never leave your device.
 Optional Permissions 
• Show Notifications, Run Foreground Service: To display a notification if a backup fails or if reminders are triggered
• Schedule exact Alarms: To schedule reminder notifications at exact date-times
• Prevent Phone from Sleeping, Run at Startup: Used by the auto backup feature to ensure backups keep happening even if your phone is restarted
• Record audio: when recording an audio note
• Use Biometrics: if Biometric/PIN app lock setting is enabled, to unlock the app
 Note 
Due to a bug on Xiaomi's part, some MiUI devices might not be able to access the text formatting options.
https://github.com/Crustack/NotallyX

fdroid:com.tharunbirla.librecuts.summary: LibreCuts is a free, open-source privacy friendly video editor for Android.

LibreCuts is a free and open-source video editor for Android focused on simplicity, performance, and privacy. Edit and export watermark free videos entirely on your device.

 Features 
 Trim: Remove unwanted parts from the beginning or end of a video.
 Merge: Combine multiple video clips and rearrange them.
 Overlays: Add text, images, GIFs, and video overlays.
 Subtitles: Import .srt subtitle files and reposition captions in the preview.
 Layer Management: Reorder overlay layers.
 Audio: Import audio, boost volume up to 200%, or mute the original audio.

 Speed: Speed up or slow down videos.

 Timeline Tools: Snap clips, duplicate overlays, and create freeze frames.

fdroid:contact.emergency.codes.name: Contact
fdroid:contact.emergency.codes.summary: Calling and messaging with built-in emergency tools
fdroid:contact.emergency.codes.description:
Contact enhances everyday calling and messaging with built-in emergency tools, including silent text-to-911, live video dispatch, real-time location sharing, medical-profile relay, and routing to 988, 311, and 211.
The 911, 988, 311, and 211 integrations are designed for services in the United States. Availability and emergency numbers differ in other countries.
The application provides familiar calls, messages, contacts, a keypad, and recent activity without requiring a separate emergency workflow.
Contact is not a certified emergency service. Its emergency integrations are experimental and educational, and availability depends on device, carrier, location, and public-safety infrastructure.

fdroid:de.computerelite.shockalarm.name: ShockAlarm
fdroid:de.computerelite.shockalarm.summary: Full featured Cross Platform OpenShock Client optimized for Mobile usage
fdroid:de.computerelite.shockalarm.description:
ShockAlarm is a powerful tool for controlling and managing your Shockers with OpenShock. It allows you to fully manage your shockers, logs, shares, hubs, share links, api tokens and more.
There is advanced functionaity like setting alarms, controling multiple shockers at the same time and specifying a random interval for intensity, duration or a delay (if you're into that).
It's fully material you themed just like the standard Android apps you're already used to and provides a responsive ui with a nice design.
Furthermore it fixes some layout flaws of the official OpenShock Frontend like having shared and own shockers in seperate tabs (which is annoying). On top it also has lots of info buttons you can press to get more insight on what something does.
ShockAlarm aims to be a feature complete client supporting all features supported by OpenShock and expanding on them
This app uses https://openshock.app/ by default however self hosted instances can be used as well.

fdroid:de.pascalstier.fossyprotokoll.name: Fossy Protokoll
fdroid:de.pascalstier.fossyprotokoll.summary: Document rental defects and build protocols — offline, no tracking.
fdroid:de.pascalstier.fossyprotokoll.description:
Fossy Protokoll helps tenants in Germany keep a verifiable record of defects in
their flat: noise disturbance, mould, heating failures and more.
From the recorded occurrences it builds a protocol covering a chosen period, and
a factual defect notification addressed to the landlord. Both can be saved and
shared as PDF or Markdown.
 Note: the app is in German 
The interface and all generated documents are written in German, because they
follow German residential tenancy practice.
 Not legal advice 
The app documents, it does not advise. The generated texts cite no statutes,
claim no rent reduction and set no deadline of their own. A response date only
appears when you enter one yourself.
 Everything stays on the device 
Data lives in a local database, photos in the app's private directory. The app
requests no permission that touches your data or the device, never accesses
the network, and contains no
tracking or analytics. When you export something, you choose the destination
yourself.
Android's automatic backup is switched off as well, so your defects and photos
never reach a cloud account. Instead you can create a full backup as a ZIP file
at any time and restore it later, for instance when moving to a new phone.
Without such a backup the data is lost if the device is.
 Features 
* Manage tenant profile, rental units and landlords
* Record defects by category: noise, mould, heating, hot water, damp, sanitary,
 electrics, windows and doors, pests, other
* Document individual occurrences with period, category, affected room,
 severity, impact, witnesses and notes
* Attach photos to defects and to individual occurrences, with captions
* Assemble protocols over a period and refresh them later
* Generate a defect notification for the landlord
* Export as PDF with embedded photos, or as Markdown
* Full backup and restore as a ZIP file
 Free and open source 
The source code is available under GPL-3.0-or-later. The app uses no proprietary
libraries.

fdroid:de.singular.crystalball.name: Crystal Ball
fdroid:de.singular.crystalball.summary: Detects guitar chords and combines them into song sheets.
fdroid:de.singular.crystalball.description:
Crystal Ball listens to your guitar and tells you what chord you just played. Press Detect single chord, strum, and it names the chord and draws how to fret it — with the chords it nearly picked instead one tap away, and other ways to play the same one further up the neck. Capture a whole part and it becomes a song sheet you can keep, correct and share.
Early-stage release — expect rough edges. Feedback and bug reports welcome via Issues.
Features:
* Detect a chord by ear — press, strum, done. It listens until the answer settles rather than for a fixed time, so a clean open chord resolves in about a third of a second; strumming again restarts it, so a bad take needs no second press.
* Ranked alternatives — the best fit is a guess, not ground truth, so the runner-ups sit under it and one tap swaps the page over to any of them.
* Chord shapes, not just names — the most idiomatic grip drawn large, plus other voicings walking up the neck. Open shapes are the ones a player expects to see, by name.
* Capo-aware — detection is unaffected (the microphone hears the real chord either way), but the shapes are redrawn behind the capo, fret numbers stay as printed on your neck, and anything the capo pushes off the end is dropped rather than offered. Chords can be named by what you hear or by the shape your hands make.
* Song sheets — capture a part chord by chord, name it Intro or Chorus, reorder the parts, and read the whole song back as diagrams. Parts can be renamed, chords fixed by hand without playing them again, and the finished sheet shared to any app.
* Chord dictionary — look any of 252 chords up by hand, without playing a note. Power chords, sixths, ninths, 6/9 and 13ths included.
* Chord finder — set the dots on a guitar neck and it names the shape, slash bass included, with other names for the same notes and chords a finger away. Behind a capo it names what sounds, and the capo drags along the neck.
* English and German — pick the app's language without changing the whole phone. German note names (H/B) are a separate switch, since being taught H is not the same as reading German.
* Session comforts — System/Light/Dark themes, keep-screen-on, an optional capo prompt at launch, an in-app quick help sheet, and backup/restore for your songs. Preferences persist across launches.
Heard: maj, min, 7, maj7, m7, sus2, sus4, across all 12 roots. Drawn: those plus 5, dim, aug, m7b5, dim7, 7sus4, 6, m6, add9, 9, maj9, m9, 6/9 and 13 — yours to look up and write down, though the microphone will not name them. Shapes assume standard tuning (EADGBE).
Honest about accuracy: template matching on clean triads is good, and degrades on a boomy room, a badly tuned guitar, or a phone held across the room. It is a practice aid, not ground truth — hence the runner-up row, which is one tap from correcting it.
Microphone access is required — listening to your guitar is the whole app. Audio is analysed on the fly and never recorded, stored or sent anywhere; the app has no network permission at all.
No ads, no trackers, no network access.

fdroid:io.github.adithya_jayan.myreperto.name: Repertoire
fdroid:io.github.adithya_jayan.myreperto.summary: An app for musicians to track their repertoire and media.
fdroid:io.github.adithya_jayan.myreperto.description:
Repertoire is a cross-platform application designed for musicians, dancers, magicians, or performers to help manage their repertoire (musical pieces, dance routines, or even magic tricks).
The app helps you keep your sheet music, notes, audio recordings, videos, links, and practice logs neatly organized for every piece in your collection.
 - Create a library of your pieces/songs, with all related information attached. 
 - Save related media like recordings, links and notes in one consolidated location. 
 - Log your practice sessions. Keep in touch with stuff you learnt over time.
 - Tag your pieces and organize your gallery into groups. Quick and easy search and filter functionality to find what you want.
 - Various quality of life features, like thumbnails for your pieces, speed control for audio (If you want to practice slow), etc.
 - Personalization options to make it to your liking, and automated and manual backup options so you don't lose any data.

fdroid:net.opendasharchive.openarchive.r.name: Save by OpenArchive
fdroid:net.opendasharchive.openarchive.r.summary: Safely preserve, organize, and share your mobile media

* Upload any type of media to a private server or directly to the Internet Archive and the WebDAV Servers.

fdroid:org.koreader.launcher.fdroid.name: KOReader
fdroid:org.koreader.launcher.fdroid.description:
KOReader is an ebook reader optimized for e-ink screens. It can open many formats and provides advanced text adjustments.
 See below for a selection of its many features:
 Supports both fixed page formats (PDF, DjVu, CBT, CBZ) and reflowable e-book formats (EPUB, FB2, Mobi, DOC, CHM, TXT, HTML). Scanned PDF/DjVu documents can be reflowed. Special flow directions for reading double column PDFs and manga.
 Multi-lingual user interface optimized for e-ink screens. Highly customizable reader view with complete typesetting options. Multi-lingual hyphenation dictionaries are bundled in.
 Non-Latin script support for books, including the Hebrew, Arabic, Persian, Russian, Chinese, Japanese and Korean languages.
 Unique Book Map and Page Browser features to navigate your book.
 Special multi-page highlight mode with many local and online export options.
 Can synchronize your reading progress across all your KOReader running devices.
 Integrated with Calibre, Wallabag, Wikipedia, Google Translate and other content providers.

fdroid:org.smssecure.smssecure.name: Silence
fdroid:org.smssecure.smssecure.description:
NOTE: App has is not been developed any more and its source repo is no longer available.
Silence is an SMS/MMS application that allows you to protect your privacy while communicating with friends.
Using Silence, you can send SMS messages and share media or attachments with complete privacy.
Features:
* Easy. Silence works like any other SMS application. There's nothing to sign up for and no new service your friends need to join.
* Reliable. Silence communicates using encrypted SMS messages. No servers or internet connection required.

* Five colour themes, including a light mode, remembered between sessions
All devices need to be on the same Wi-Fi network. Tribute (进贡) is not implemented.

flathub:com.betterstickies.BetterStickie.name: Better Stickies
flathub:com.betterstickies.BetterStickie.description:
Capture ideas, tasks, and deadlines on colorful notes that live on your desktop instead of disappearing
 into a folder. Each note holds rich text, checklists, screenshots, file shortcuts, and a reminder
 — so the thing you want to remember stays in front of you until you act on it.
 Features:
 Rich text formatting (bold, italic, strikethrough, titles)
 Customizable colors and background images
 Reminder system with desktop notifications
 Dark and light theme support
 Drag and drop file shortcuts
 Checkbox and todo lists with strikethrough
 Code block auto-detection with syntax styling
 Customizable in-app keyboard shortcuts
 Export to TXT, Markdown, JSON
 The free version includes up to 4 notes (tabs count toward the limit). Premium removes the limit
 and unlocks inside the app (About › Activate Premium…), on up to 5 computers per account. The app
 uses the network only once, at activation.

flathub:com.github.Flacon.name: Flacon
flathub:com.github.Flacon.summary: Flacon extracts individual tracks from one big audio file containing the entire album of music and saves them as separate audio files
flathub:com.github.Flacon.description:
Flacon extracts individual tracks from one big audio file containing the entire album of music
 and saves them as separate audio files. To do this, it uses information from the appropriate CUE
 file. Besides, Flacon makes it possible to conveniently revise or specify tags both for all tracks
 at once or for each tag separately.
 Supported input formats: WAV, FLAC, APE, WavPack, True Audio (TTA)
 Supported output formats: FLAC, WAV, WavPack, AAC, OGG or MP3
 Support of profiles, you can have different encoding options for different cases, such as
 maximum quality for your computer, and CD quality for your phone
 Replay Gain analysis (album-gain and track-gain modes)
 Multi-threaded conversion process
 Automatic character set detection for CUE files
 Generation of the pertrack CUE file in the output dir

flathub:com.nedrichards.octopusagile.name: Agile Rates
flathub:com.nedrichards.octopusagile.summary: Rates and usage for UK smart electricity tariffs
flathub:com.nedrichards.octopusagile.description:
Follow current and upcoming half-hour electricity rates, usage history, and estimated spend
 for supported Octopus Energy electricity tariffs in the UK.
 Check the current rate at a glance, and find the cheapest time to run appliances or charge devices.
 This app is independent and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Octopus Energy.

flathub:com.polydez.KeyVault.name: OTP Authenticator App
flathub:com.polydez.KeyVault.description:
KeyVault is a secure 2FA/OTP manager that helps you store and manage all your two-factor
 authentication codes and time-based one-time passwords (TOTP) in one secure location.
 All data is stored locally and only on your devices. This app can be used as-is or, manually sync
 2FA codes from one device to another with the import/export tool. 
 KeyVault also has an Android and Windows version which allows you to import/export your codes
 with ease and with encryption (offline). 
 Features:
 Secure storage for all your 2FA and OTP tokens (keys are stored on device, never online)
 Automatic TOTP code generation
 Easy organization of authentication codes
 Cross-platform support (Android, Windows available, with Mac and iPhone coming soon)
 Pro Features (unlocked with KeyVault Pro License on Android)
 Create and categorize your OTP codes
 Customize your OTP codes with colors and icons
 Personalize KeyVault OTP app with custom themes
 Activate PIN for security

flathub:com.thincast.client.name: Thincast Remote Desktop Client
flathub:com.thincast.client.summary: A free RDP (Remote Desktop Protocol) Client for Linux, macOS and Windows
flathub:com.thincast.client.description:
Thincast Client allows you to connect to virtual applications and desktops over the RDP (Remote Desktop Protocol). It offers features like built-in support for redirecting webcams, configuring remote apps, regular security updates and hardware-accelerated video decoding to extend the battery life of your device, ideal when working on the go. Using the Remote Desktop (RD) WebAccess Client you gain easy access to and control of published virtual machines (with Thincast Workstation), desktop sessions and applications. Initial support for 64-bit ARM based devices (aarch64 only) like Raspberry Pi has been added with V. 1.0.184.
 As of today, we are the main contributor to the FreeRDP project.

flathub:dev.aadhil.devtpro.name: DevT Pro
flathub:dev.aadhil.devtpro.summary: Essential developer tools in one fast, offline app
flathub:dev.aadhil.devtpro.description:
DevT Pro brings more than 100 everyday developer tools into one fast, keyboard-friendly desktop
 app. Convert, format, validate, inspect and generate data without sending anything to a server.
 Convert between JSON, XML, YAML, CSV, TSV, TOML and TOON
 Generate Java, C#, TypeScript, Python, Dart and Kotlin models from JSON
 Format, minify and validate JSON, XML, YAML, SQL, HTML, CSS and JavaScript
 Encode and decode URLs, Base64 and JWTs, with tree and table viewers for structured data
 Generate hashes, encrypt text, and create UUIDs, ULIDs, passwords and secret keys
 Test regular expressions, compare text, convert timestamps and parse cron expressions
 Generate and read QR codes
 Quickly find any tool with the command palette, work across multiple tabs, and drag files directly
 into supported editors.
 DevT Pro is free to use with a limited set of tools. A one-time license key, bought from a link
 in the app, unlocks every tool, the devtpro command line, the MCP server and deep links.

flathub:org.kde.kid3.name: Kid3
flathub:org.kde.kid3.description:
With Kid3, an audio tag editor, you can edit tags in MP3, Ogg/Vorbis, DSF, FLAC, Opus, MPC,
 APE, MP4/AAC, MP2, Speex, TrueAudio, WavPack, WMA, WAV, AIFF and tracker files.
 All frames in the ID3 tags of MP3 files can be edited, and it is possible to convert between
 ID3v1.1, ID3v2.3 and ID3v2.4. Synchronized lyrics can be edited, imported and exported to LRC Karaoke
 files.
 The tags of multiple files can be set together. It is possible to generate tags from file names
 or the contents of other tag fields and to generate file names from tags and rename folders from
 tags. Automatic case conversion and string replacement help to keep tags consistent.
 Album data can be imported from gnudb.org, MusicBrainz, Discogs, Amazon; automatic batch import
 is available for multiple folders. It is also possible to export data and generate play lists.
 Kid3 uses the KDE Frameworks. Users of other desktop environments may prefer Kid3-qt instead,
 which is without KDE dependencies.

flathub:org.kde.kpat.name: KPatience

flathub:org.sil.dictionary-app-builder.name: Dictionary App Builder
flathub:org.sil.dictionary-app-builder.description: Dictionary App Builder helps you to build customized dictionary apps for Android and iOS smartphones and tablets. You specify the lexicon data file to use, the app name, fonts, colors, the about box information, the audio, illustrations and the icons. Dictionary App Builder will package everything together and build the customized app for you. You can then install it on your phone, send it to others by Bluetooth, share it on microSD memory cards and publish it to app stores on the Internet.

firefox-addons:945329.name: Open With Internet Download Manager
firefox-addons:945329.summary: Open and download desired links with internet download manager.
firefox-addons:945329.description:
Open With Internet Download Manager is a browser extension that enables you to open and download a desired item with an Internet Download Manager (IDM) application. 
To operate with this add-on you need a native-client patch to connect your browser with native IDM application in your OS. Please read the following to get more info on how to install native-client and operate with this add-on.
1) after installing the add-on, you need to connect it with native applications (i.e. IDM) on your machine. If you do not have IDM, please head to ( internetdownloadmanager.com/download.html ) and install IDM on your machine. Once you have IDM, you need to make the connection between IDM and your browser.
2) to make this connection, a separate patch is provided in GitHub. Please download and install this patch from: https://github.com/alexmarcoo/open-in-native-client/releases 
Follow the instruction in the above GitHub repo to download and install the related patch to your system. After installing, the "Open With Internet Download Manager" add-on, your browser can communicate with IDM on your machine (i.e. Window OS).
3) before using the add-on, please open the option's page and make sure the path to IDM is correct based on your operating system. For example, the path to IDM in Window 10 is: C:\Program Files (x86)\Internet Download Manager\IDMan.exe
Next, please follow the below steps to open and download desired links in IDM.
a. right click on a download link and then click on the - Download with Internet Download Manager - from the context-menu.
b. IDM has several input arguments to enhance downloading desired files. The default argument for downloading is: /d. To get more info about other arguments please open the add-on option's page and read section arguments. Please note that, you need to add parameters comma separated, for example to automatically download a file write: "/d,/n" in the designated area.
c. you can set the IDM path in your machine from the options page.
To report any bug, please fill the bug report form in the add-on's homepage .

firefox-addons:3118620.name: CherryPickd: Smarter Shopping Checkout
firefox-addons:3118620.summary: Cherry-pick what you buy across 62,000+ stores. Check out with today's picks, then restore the rest to your cart with one click.
firefox-addons:3118620.description:
Your cart has 8 things. You want to buy 2 today. CherryPickd lets you check out with just those 2, and keeps the other 6 safe so you can put them back in one click.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Open your cart. Click the CherryPickd button next to Checkout.
2. Mark each item Today or Later. You see the total for today's items as you go.
3. Click to set the Later items aside. Big cart? Tap "All later", then tap Today on the few you want. CherryPickd takes them out of the store cart (on stores with tick boxes, like SHEIN, it unticks them) and keeps a list in your browser.
4. Check out as normal.
5. Come back and click "Put back". CherryPickd adds the items to your cart again and checks the cart to make sure they really arrived. If an item did not come back (for example, it sold out), it tells you which one.
PRICE DROPS ON SAVED ITEMS
When you visit a store, CherryPickd checks today's price of the items you saved from that store (up to 8 items, at most once every 6 hours) and shows you when a price went down. It only checks while you are on the store. It does not run in the background, and it does not work on Target or SHEIN yet.
WHERE IT WORKS
• Switches on at 62,000+ online stores built on Shopify, WooCommerce and BigCommerce.
• Also has store code for big stores such as Amazon, Target, Walmart, SHEIN, SKIMS, Ulta Beauty, Gap, Nordstrom, Mango, H&M, Macy's, Best Buy, Canada Goose, Lancôme and Jomashop. If a store does not work in Firefox, email us.
• On any other Shopify, WooCommerce or BigCommerce shop, click the CherryPickd icon (in the toolbar or the Extensions menu) and choose "Turn on for this shop".
• Desktop Firefox.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No site access at install. You turn it on one store at a time, and you can turn it off at any time.
• Your set-aside items stay in this browser. They are not sent to us.
• No account, no sign-in, no passwords.
• No affiliate links, codes or cookies. CherryPickd never replaces a creator's link or code.
FREE
CherryPickd is free to use.
Questions or a store that does not work? Email support@getcherrypickd.com .

bluejetty:00044512:ios.description: The FAY Fix It app is your tool to help improve the City of Fayetteville, North Carolina. Whether it is a pothole, damaged street sign or graffiti, FAY Fix It makes reporting a code or ordinance violation to City Hall as easy as pressing a button. The app harnesses the power of GPS to provide a precise location for staff so that they can begin fixing the problem. You can also include a photo with your reporting to help the City quickly identify the problem. The mobile app can be used for a variety of issues such as reporting problems with graffiti, street maintenance, street lighting, damaged trees, overgrown grass, abandoned vehicles, aggressive panhandling and litter. Residents will be able to track the status of their report or follow other reports made by members of the community.

bluejetty:00043589:ios.description:
Welcome to My Tizi Interior Design Games, Unleash your interior designer, room planner creativity in crafting the perfect modern kitchen, furniture and improve home decorating skills With a plethora of features including creating cute adorable characters, selecting top-notch home decor furniture, personalizing bedrooms, concocting engaging stories, and designing chic living room spaces, this game is a dream come true for interior design and room planner enthusiasts.
Step into the world of professional modular home decor and unleash your Home Decorating imagination with our vast collection of modern furniture options. Whether you're into sleek minimalism or cozy chic, our selection caters to every taste and style preference. From luxurious modern sofas to elegant kitchen remodels, we've got it all covered.
With our intuitive interface, home decorating has never been easier. Dive into the realm of interior design and explore endless possibilities as you plan, arrange, and adorn your dream home with exquisite wall decor, trendy room ideas, and state-of-the-art modern furniture. Elevate your living space with meticulously curated pieces that exude sophistication and style.
Indulge in the luxury of modern house planning as you transform mundane spaces into stunning showcases of elegance and comfort. With our comprehensive house planner tool, you have the power to create the ultimate home sanctuary tailored to your unique vision. Whether it's a cozy living room retreat or a sleek, contemporary kitchen, the possibilities are endless.
Immerse yourself in the world of modern home design and unleash your creativity as you embark on a journey of self-expression and discovery. From luxurious luxury homes to charming room designs, Tizi Town offers a wealth of inspiration to fuel your imagination. Let your creativity run wild as you experiment with different layouts, color schemes, and decor elements to create a space that truly reflects your personal style.
Embark on a journey into the realm of professional modular home decor where imagination knows no bounds. Within Tizi Town's expansive collection of furniture options, discover a symphony of styles catering to every discerning taste. Whether your aesthetic leans towards the sleek lines of modern minimalism or the inviting warmth of cozy chic, our selection promises to inspire and delight.
Navigate through our user-friendly interface, designed to make home decorating a breeze. With just a few taps, transform your living space into a sanctuary of style and comfort. Explore the endless possibilities of interior design as you adorn your walls with exquisite decor, experiment with trendy room ideas, and select from a range of modern furniture pieces that redefine sophistication.
Experience the pinnacle of luxury with our modern house planning feature. Say goodbye to uninspired spaces and hello to bespoke elegance as you wield our comprehensive house planner tool. Craft the perfect backdrop for your lifestyle, whether it's a tranquil living room haven or a sleek, contemporary kitchen designed for culinary adventures.
Fuel your creativity with Tizi Town's boundless array of modern home design options. From opulent luxury homes to charmingly curated room designs, there's something to ignite your imagination at every turn. Let your style shine through as you mix and match layouts, experiment with color palettes, and infuse your space with unique decor elements.
In My Tizi Interior Design Games, the canvas is yours to paint. Don't let your dreams be confined by walls—break free and create the modern home you've always envisioned. The journey to interior design excellence begins now. Are you ready to make your mark? Dive in and start crafting your dream home today!

bluejetty:00017051:ios.description:
Discover epic sceneries as you pop, crush and journey through this stunning underwater world of the deep blue sea. Who needs an aquarium when you can build your own Reef?! Complete challenging and fun match-3 puzzles to win coins and rescue fish! 
Be a hero as you smash and collect gems, blast through obstacles, farm coins and rejuvenate your Reef as you buy the most prestigious decorations. Share photos of your brilliant fish to become the envy of your Facebook best friends. Watch your fish splash around as your Reef comes to life!
Features:
- Craft your underwater paradise as you blitz through hundreds of match-3 levels.
- Feed, play with and watch the true stars of your reef: your fish!
- Collect stars to level up and unlock jam packed chests filled with treasure.
- Win rewards daily by spinning the Bonus Slot.
- Complete unique task as you pop and smash jelly, clean fish, drop beach balls and collect bubbles.
- Explore and unlock different Reefs as you make a splash in this All New Free Game!

By eliminating the need for paper Driver Vehicle Inspection Reports (DVIRs), we provide digitized inspection reports, while keeping you informed with real-time routing information.
USER-FRIENDLY
Our app is designed with drivers in mind, prioritizing their needs by creating the app with alerts, easy-to-use interface and large icons. Most functions can be accessed with just a few taps, ensuring simplicity and convenience. We understand that the ELD mandate can be complex, but we continuously strive to simplify FMCSA compliance for drivers.
OPTIMISED PERFORMANCE & DESIGN
We are dedicated to improving our app's speed and usability. By continuously improving our performance, we ensure our users have the best experience, while also striving to keep the app fast and stable.

App Up Your Life with UPTCL – One Smart App for Ufone & PTCL Users
Experience a seamless digital lifestyle with the UPTCL App, your one-stop solution to manage Ufone 4G, PTCL Broadband, and Flash Fiber services. From SIM purchases and bill payments to bundle subscriptions and internet upgrades — control everything securely in just a few taps.
Whether you're at home or on the go, the UPTCL app helps you stay connected, rewarded, and in control. Access your mobile and broadband accounts, manage family profiles, and enjoy exclusive daily data rewards — all in one unified app built for convenience.

Dual Network Management: Manage both Ufone and PTCL accounts with a single login. Add up to 4 profiles for family or business.

PTCL Flash Fiber Control: Boost your internet speed with one tap. Upgrade or change your Flash Fiber package directly from the app.
Smart Shopping Experience: Buy Ufone SIMs, PTCL connections, mobile broadband devices, and Flash Fiber with doorstep delivery or pickup.

• Download tax certificates

Part 2 - Australia's democratic beliefs, rights and liberties 
Part 3 - Government and the law in Australia

- You can track how many questions you have done correctly, incorrectly, and get a final passing or failing score based on official passing grades

Are you ready to take on the ultimate challenge of becoming the richest person in the world?
Welcome to Money Maker Idle, the ultimate money printing game! It is so addictive!
In this game, you will start with nothing but a simple machine that prints a few dollars per minute. But with your tapping skills and upgrades, you will turn this humble machine into a mighty money-making empire!
Tap! and upgrade. Slice your way through the game, as you unlock more powerful machines and build multiple production lanes. With each upgrade, the piles of money printed will get larger, and you'll be on your way to becoming richer than Elon himself!

So, download Money Maker Idle now and get ready to embark on the ultimate journey to get rich! With our addictive gameplay, stunning graphics, and thrilling features, you'll never want to stop playing. And who knows - you might just become the next billionaire!

bluejetty:00021685:ios.summary: At Qatar Airways, we believe your journey should be as rewarding as the destination itself. That’s why we’ve designed our mobile app to put you in complete charge – with everything you need for a seamless journey right in the palm of your h
bluejetty:00021685:ios.description:
At Qatar Airways, we believe your journey should be as rewarding as the destination itself. That’s why we’ve designed our mobile app to put you in complete charge – with everything you need for a seamless journey right in the palm of your hand.
Get the most out of our app by becoming a Privilege Club member. It’s not just about being part of the ‘club’ – it’s about embracing a new lifestyle, a passport to more of everything you love. Think bigger rewards, better benefits and a richer travel experience. And the best part? The journey doesn’t stop after you land. Our app helps you find ways to earn Avios on your everyday life, even when you’re not flying. 
Travel smarter, live bolder and embrace the journey. This is the life. 
- Be inspired. Set your location and share your travel dreams, and we’ll handle the rest. You'll get tailored recommendations, exclusive promo codes and a whole lot of inspiration right at your fingertips.
- Book like a pro. Save time and effort with our personalised search wizard that picks up right where you left off. We’re all about that smart interface. 
- Earn Avios on every booking. Make every trip count. Join Privilege Club to earn Avios on every flight you take with us or our oneworld® partners. Check your Avios balance anytime with a tap on your Profile.
- Step into the future of travel. From bookings to bites, our AI-powered cabin crew, Sama, is here to help. Chat with Sama to book your dream destination or let her customise your menu in Business and First Class. 
- Double your adventure with a stopover. Explore Qatar during your journey with stopover packages starting from USD 14 per person. Easily tap to book for a taste of local culture, desert adventures, world-class shopping and more.
- Fast, easy and secure. Simply pay and go with convenient payment options, including e-wallets and one-click payments like Apple Pay and Google Pay. 
- Take full control of your journey. Add your trip and manage your booking on the go. Check in and download your digital boarding pass, make flight changes, select seats and more. 
- Add more for less. Travelling with special baggage or need an e-SIM? We've got flexible options to handle it all. Purchase add-ons effortlessly and skip the queue. 
- Travel smart with Live Activities. Get dynamic updates and see trip details right from your Lock Screen. Think check-in and gate information, boarding reminders and more. 
- Raise the bar. Stream, scroll and double tap at 35,000 feet with Starlink – the fastest Wi-Fi in the sky. Remember, Starlink is available on select routes, at no extra cost to you. 
- It’s all in the hub. Explore your benefits, rewards and all the ways you can collect and spend Avios in your Profile dashboard. Plus, get a sneak peek at what’s available on the next tier.

bluejetty:00025369:ios.summary:
Bible Crossword Games – Daily Crossword Puzzles with Bible Verses and Scripture Study
Bible Crossword Games is a relaxing Christian crossword game designed to help you enjoy Scripture, learn Bible verses, and spend peaceful time with God e
bluejetty:00025369:ios.description:
Bible Crossword Games – Daily Crossword Puzzles with Bible Verses and Scripture Study
Bible Crossword Games is a relaxing Christian crossword game designed to help you enjoy Scripture, learn Bible verses, and spend peaceful time with God every day. If you enjoy Bible games, crossword puzzles, word search games, or Christian learning apps, this is the perfect place to grow your faith while challenging your mind.
This app combines classic crossword gameplay with Bible verses, Scripture clues, and faith-based themes. Every puzzle is built around the Word of God, helping you reflect, study, and relax. Bible Crossword Games is ideal for anyone seeking a calm and meaningful alternative to traditional crossword games.
Designed for Bible Learning, Relaxation, and Daily Scripture Practice
Each crossword puzzle contains clues inspired by Bible stories, well-known verses, and essential faith concepts. As you solve clues and complete each crossword, you will unlock encouraging Scriptures that help you stay rooted in God’s truth.
This is more than a game. It is a daily habit of Scripture reflection, verse meditation, and quiet time with God.
Key Features:
1. Bible-Based Crossword Puzzles
Explore crossword levels built entirely around Bible verses and Scripture themes. Each clue leads you deeper into the meaning of God’s Word.
2. Daily Crossword Verse Challenges
A new verse puzzle is available every day. Build a daily habit of reading, studying, and reflecting on Scripture through simple, meaningful puzzles.
3. Relaxing Christian Gameplay
Designed with peaceful backgrounds and calming visuals to support quiet, focused gameplay. Perfect for morning devotion, evening reflection, or a break during the day.
4. Learn Bible Verses Through Pla
Every completed puzzle unlocks a verse from the Holy Bible. Use these moments to study Scripture, strengthen faith, and commit God’s Word to memory.
5. Multiple Bible Puzzle Modes
Choose from various puzzle styles:
Classic Bible crosswords
Scripture-based clue puzzles
Verse discovery challenges
Play at a relaxing pace or choose more brain-stimulating levels.
6. Encouraging Scripture Rewards
Unlock verses that inspire hope, build faith, and remind you of God’s promises. Each level offers meaningful encouragement.
7. Christian-Friendly and Family-Friendly
Designed for players of all ages. Enjoy wholesome Bible games suitable for children, teens, adults, and seniors.
8. Offline Bible Crossword Play
Play anywhere, anytime, without internet. Ideal for devotion time, travel, church activities, and quiet study moments.
9. Simple to Begin, Meaningful to Grow
Start with easy crosswords and progress into deeper Scripture-based puzzles that expand your Bible vocabulary and understanding.
10. Track Your Progress and Scripture Journey
Follow your puzzle completion, verses collected, and milestones achieved as you grow in both Bible knowledge and puzzle mastery.
Why Bible Crossword Games Is Loved by Christian Players
Built specifically for Bible study and Scripture reflection
Helps you relax while staying connected to God’s Word
Strengthens Bible knowledge through simple, enjoyable puzzles
Ideal for building a daily Bible reading routine
A refreshing alternative to traditional crossword and word games
Suitable for personal devotion, family time, and Christian groups
Grow Spiritually with Every Crossword Puzzle
Bible Crossword Games is designed to help you spend peaceful, focused time with Scripture. Whether you want to deepen your understanding of the Bible, enjoy meaningful relaxation, or build a daily faith habit, this app makes it simple and enjoyable.
Download Bible Crossword Games Today
Join thousands of believers who are discovering Scripture, strengthening their faith, and enjoying relaxing Bible crossword puzzles every day.
Start your journey of learning, reflection, and spiritual growth through the Word of God, one puzzle at a time.

bluejetty:00018088:ios.name: LSBTexas Mobile
bluejetty:00018088:ios.summary: The Lone Star Bank App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay
bluejetty:00018088:ios.description:
The Lone Star Bank App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Lone Star Bank customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the Lone Star Bank App, you must be enrolled as a Lone Star Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00024176:ios.name: IKEA Home smart
bluejetty:00024176:ios.summary:
With IKEA Home smart app and DIRIGERA hub, it's easy to create smarter everyday moments with lighting, speakers, blinds and air quality products.
Picture yourself waking up as your smart lights gently rise. Your favourite songs play on the
bluejetty:00024176:ios.description:
With IKEA Home smart app and DIRIGERA hub, it's easy to create smarter everyday moments with lighting, speakers, blinds and air quality products.
Picture yourself waking up as your smart lights gently rise. Your favourite songs play on the speakers and you still haven't gotten out of bed. How lovely, right? Smart products like lighting, speakers, blinds and air purifiers can make a lovely addition to your everyday life. When you improve the IQ of your home, life itself runs a bit smoother.
The magic happens when you combine two or more smart products from IKEA, tell them what to do in the app and save it as a 'Scene'.
A great scene is one you will use often. Think about waking up and going to bed, cooking and eating, date night and family time, or leaving and coming home. All everyday moments when we can support you with the best lighting, sound that suits your mood, and cleaner air.
When it comes to control, we think of everyone, from young to old and even visitors. So while the app gives you total control to customise your smart home, our range of remotes make it easy for everyone to live with and use a smart home.
In control 
• You can control products individually or in groups. You can turn whole rooms on and off or the whole home, all at once.
• Dim and change light colours, adjust blinds, speaker volume, and much more.
• Set the scenes you need and trigger them with schedules, a shortcut button or use the app.
Easy to use
• The home screen gives a fast overview of your whole home. Quickly control products, access rooms, or start/stop scenes. This is also where you add new products, rooms, and scenes. 
Organised and personal
• Organising your smart products in rooms gives fast access to the products you want to control.
• Personalise the app with your choice of icons, names and colours for rooms and products
• Create personal scenes, for example your own combination of cosy lighting and your favourite music. 
Integrations
• Connect to Apple Home, Amazon Alexa or Google Home to use a voice assistant.

bluejetty:00028641:android.description:
In the grim darkness of the far future, there is only war.
Warhammer 40,000: Warpforge is a fast-paced digital collectible card game (CCG) set in the vast, war-torn Warhammer 40K universe of the 41st millennium. Build powerful decks, command legendary factions, and fight across the galaxy in both single-player campaigns and competitive multiplayer battles. Collect all cards from the 6 factions available at launch, each with distinct mechanics, strengths, and strategies.
- Factions - 
• Space Marines: The Emperor’s finest warriors, adaptable and disciplined. 
• Goff Orks: Savage and unpredictable, the Orks rely on brute force, randomness, and overwhelming numbers. 
• Sautekh Necrons: Deathless legions that rise again to overwhelm enemies with sheer inevitability.
• Black Legion: The dark gods of the Warp grant their chosen followers forbidden powers, but at a cost.
• Saim-Hann Aeldari: Masters of speed and precision, the Aeldari focus on fast strikes and deception.
• Leviathan Tyranids: The Great Devourer comes in endless waves, evolving and mutating to adapt to any foe. 
Each faction in Warpforge plays differently, offering a variety of strategic options whether you prefer brute force, clever tactics, or unpredictable chaos!
- Game Modes -
• Campaign Mode (PvE): Dive into the rich lore of Warhammer 40K by playing through faction-driven campaigns. These narrative-driven battles introduce the personalities, conflicts, and motivations behind each faction, allowing players to experience iconic moments from the 41st millennium.
• Ranked PvP Battles: Climb the ranks, refine your deck strategies, and prove yourself as a master tactician of the far future against other players worldwide.
• Raids: Large-scale conflicts where entire player communities battle to unlock new special cards.
• Limited-Time Events & Draft Mode: Take on special challenges with unique deck-building restrictions or play in limited-time draft-style modes where every match is a test of improvisation and skill.
Prepare your forces, build and customize your deck, and enter the battlefield. Only the strongest will survive in the 41st millennium!

bluejetty:00033545:ios.description:
Welcome to Monster Hunter Puzzles! Explore the world of Monster Hunter through a cast of cute Felyne characters while solving challenging puzzles!
- Introduction
The Felyne Isles may seem like a peaceful corner of the Monster Hunter universe, but all is not well... Monsters are rampaging, making life miserable for the residents.
- Solve puzzles and help Felynes get back on their paws!
All of the "Catizens" have their own stories. Listen to what they need and solve their problems to bring the island back to life! There's drama waiting to unfold on every corner of these isles. Come join these cute Felynes on their soon-to-be island paradise!
Advanced Match 3 Puzzles
- Pieces move diagonally as well as vertically and horizontally!
- Solve puzzles to repel the monsters that appear!
- Make tons of special pieces during "Meowllocation Time"!
- Populate your island with new Felynes by solving puzzles!
- Raise your "Pawtential" and earn skills that will help solve puzzles!
- Compete with players around the world and earn ranking rewards!
Capcom—the company behind Monster Hunter, Resident Evil, Street Fighter, and Mega Man—now presents a casual and cute match 3 puzzle game. The destination? The Felyne Isles!
- What will you build!? Pick out buildings that fit perfectly with the Felynes and the island.
- Get to know these unique critters as you take them through the trials and tribulations of getting their businesses running again!
- Collect materials and exchange them for outfits to deck out your Felyne avatar with the latest fashion!
Note: The basic game is free to play, but there are some premium items available for purchase.
iOS Support:
- iOS 16.0 or later
- iPhone 11 or later, iPhone SE (3nd generation or later)
iPad Support:
- iPadOS 16.0 or later
- iPad (10th generation or later)
- iPad Pro 12.9-inch (3rd generation or later), iPad Pro 11-inch (1st generation or later), iPad Pro 10.5-inch
- iPad mini (6th generation or later)
- iPad Air (4rd generation or later)
Terms of Use
https://mobile.capcom.com/mhpuzzle/?tl=terms

bluejetty:00042974:ios.description:
My Health is an application for connecting with smart wearable devices, and provides you with interesting and professional analyses of running, steps, weight management etc.This application's core functions are as follows:
1. Manage smart wearable devices: Users can connect mobile devices with smart wearable devices (such as smart watches etc.) for a more convenient life of receiving calls, reminding of sedentary, synchronizing messages, app reminder etc...
2. Data synchronization between the mobile phone and the device: With the support of smart wearable devices, it can provide users with interesting and professional analyses of running, steps, sleep, etc.. 
3. Step counting: accurate step counter. Easily set daily step goals to constantly motivate yourself; know how many steps taken at a glance.
4. Running, Walking, Cycling and more sports: route tracker, voice reminder, data analysis, etc. Monitor and understand how you run every time.
5. Professional health knowledge of sleep and more.
6. With the support of smart wearable devices, accurately monitor different stages of sleep (awake, light, deep), and provide scientific advice to help you sleep more soundly.
Feel free to tell us what you think about the app and what to improve via [My Health APP – Me – About - User Feedback]. Thank you.
This product is not a professional medical device. Measurement data and results are for reference only and cannot be used as a basis for clinical diagnosis and treatment. Seek a doctor’s advice in addition to using this app and before making any medical decisions.

bluejetty:00029297:ios.name: GPS Camera 55. Field Survey
bluejetty:00029297:ios.summary: Capture photos and videos with precise location, date, address, and custom notes overlaid directly on them. Add hand-drawn annotations to photos for quick markups in the field. Easily search and filter your shots by title, tags, or notes —
bluejetty:00029297:ios.description:
Capture photos and videos with precise location, date, address, and custom notes overlaid directly on them. Add hand-drawn annotations to photos for quick markups in the field. Easily search and filter your shots by title, tags, or notes — or sort them by proximity and date. Organize everything into folders or collections for structured reporting. Need to work with older photos? Import from your library and restore their location, direction, and notes automatically.
LOCATION OVERLAY 
Supports decimal, DM, DMS, UTM, and MGRS coordinate formats. 
True or magnetic heading, in degrees or mils. 
Accuracy and altitude in feet or meters.
CAMERA AND CAPTURE SETTINGS 
Save photos automatically or open in preview to annotate before saving. 
Option to save a copy to the photo library — original, stamped, or both.
Record location-aware field video with map, QR code, watermark, speed, and motion overlays, then replay recordings in the app. The basic version stores one video and exports a branded clip of up to 15 seconds.
ANNOTATE AND COMMENT 
Before or after saving, zoom in/out and draw directly on the photo using your finger or Apple Pencil. 
Crop, resize, rotate, or tilt the photo before or after saving.
Notes overlay supports Title, Note, Tags/Folder, and Address. 
Address can be auto-filled from GPS or entered manually. 
Edit notes and add annotations later (MENU > POINTS > tap an image). 
Tapping a point row opens the editor, where you can add an audio note. 
Timestamps support many formats and languages.
Scan QR codes, barcodes, or text and use the result for the title or note field.
WATERMARK 
The Pro Pack upgrade removes the basic version watermark and allows you to set up a watermark with your own image, text, and colors, if needed.
SHARE AND EXCHANGE 
Share multiple points via MENU > POINTS, or entire collections via MENU > POINT COLLECTIONS. 
Images can be shared with or without location/notes text, and with or without overlays. 
Photo filenames can include title, note, address, tags/folder name, collection, coordinates, altitude, heading, or capture date. 
To transfer complete points and images to another device, use KMZ (Google Earth archive) — includes photos, notes, annotations, and audio.
PDF REPORTS 
Generate and share PDF documents for the selected photos/points or whole collection/folder, with options for the number of images per page and photo descriptions.
ORGANIZE, SEARCH & SORT 
You can organize images into collections/folders. Existing images/points can be moved between collections. 
Search by notes, address, or tags; filter by creation month; sort by proximity; or show only one collection.
IMPORT 
Import photos from your library. The app reads TIFF/EXIF/GPS/IPTC metadata to restore location, direction, and notes for the stamp.
NAVIGATE 
Navigate back to any saved photo/point from its editor.
MAP VIEW 
Review any saved photo/point and its location on the map.
== PRO PACK UPGRADE ==
You can do a lot with the basic functions in the app. The PRO PACK upgrade adds:
- Ability to create additional point/image collections. 
- Enables sharing of more than 5 points/images at once. 
- Export/import capabilities — in particular, KMZ export/import enables transfer of collections or selected waypoints between devices. 
- Ability to save hand-drawn annotations for the image. 
- Crop, resize, rotate, or tilt the photo before or after saving.
- Extra protection of your work and privacy with PIN code or biometric-based access options. 
- Removes the basic version watermark and allows you to apply a custom watermark with your image, text, and colors.
- Unlimited saved videos and full-length stamped or original video exports.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00014381:ios.description:
Manage your firm from anywhere with LEX Reception’s mobile app. 
Free yourself from the office with a 24/7 live answering service. Manage Your Calls
 - View your call log and messages
 - Call and text clients from your business line
 - Listen to call recordings
 - Add, verify and manage your contacts

 - Update your status to instantly change your availability
Connect With Your Team
 - Message and video call your team members
 - Create groups for instant collaboration
 - Send and receive files

bluejetty:00009976:android.description:
🎇Zumba Shooter - Classic is a type of Marble shooter games, where you have to marble shoot rows of colorful marble lines to eliminate them. The Zumba Shooter - Classic the balls or marbles will come in the Marble and you have to aim your marble shooter carefully to create match three marbles of the same colors.

💣 Many secret maps to make the marble shooting game more addictive.
💣 6+ magic props: Back, Pause, Magic, Lighting, Bomb, Colorful.
💣 Marble classic more, adventure mode and challenge mode.
💣 Easy to learn but difficult to master the game.

1. Touch the screen where you want to shoot. 
2. Match 3 or more same marbles to eliminate them. Destroy all the marble lines in the chain before it hits the end.
3. Marble shooting more combos and marble shooter chains to get the highest score, try to get three stars in each level in marble games!
We believe that any bravest fans of marbles legend can succeed in this game 
Now you can explore the amazing deluxe game on your lovely device.
Thanks every game players! Any suggestion is welcome!

bluejetty:00036005:ios.name: WebSSH - Sysadmin Toolbox
bluejetty:00036005:ios.summary:
Whether you're on the go or at your desk, WebSSH keeps you connected — anytime, anywhere! ٩(^‿^)۶

bluejetty:00036005:ios.description:
Whether you're on the go or at your desk, WebSSH keeps you connected — anytime, anywhere! ٩(^‿^)۶
WebSSH is a professional SSH, Mosh, SFTP, Telnet, Serial and Port Forwarding client for iPhone, iPad and Mac, with a built-in Proxmox client and a complete sysadmin toolbox. Built since 2012 for developers, system administrators and IT professionals who need reliable, secure remote access wherever they are.
CONNECT WITH CONFIDENCE
Authenticate with passwords, two-factor challenge, or keys (RSA, DSA, ED25519, PuTTY). Jump through bastion hosts, keep an alternative address per host for when you are inside or outside your network, and let known hosts protect you from surprises. Full terminal emulation (XTERM-256COLOR, XTERM, VT100) with WebGL rendering, split panes, inline images, buffer search, session recording and custom profiles — themes, fonts, colors and keyboard shortcuts tailored to your workflow.
NEW IN 33: ONE COMMAND, EVERY HOST
Run a command or a snippet on several hosts at once and watch the results come back side by side. The Terminal State Bar now shows more about the machine you are on, snippets get keyboard shortcuts on Mac, and the keyboard accessory keys can carry your own icons.
MANAGE FILES REMOTELY
The integrated SFTP and SCP client lets you browse directories, create, rename, upload and download files — and edit text files directly within the app. WebSSH can also open .txt files from anywhere on your device.
MORE THAN SSH
Mosh keeps your session alive through network changes, sleep and flaky connections — switch from Wi-Fi to cellular and pick up right where you left off. Telnet supports direct and interactive authentication, including the CP437 character set for BBS servers. Serial connections support full configuration (baud rate, parity, stop bits, flow control).
TUNNEL ANYTHING
Local and dynamic port forwarding, VPN over SSH to route your device's traffic through a server, port knocking and Wake-on-LAN to reach machines that are not listening yet.
PROXMOX AT YOUR FINGERTIPS
Connect to one or more Proxmox servers and clusters, monitor your nodes at a glance (CPU, memory, storage), and manage your VMs and LXC containers — start, stop, reboot and migrate them right from your iPhone, iPad or Mac.
SNIPPETS THAT WORK FOR YOU
Save the commands you type every day, add dynamic variables, sync them from a GitHub Gist and fire them with a shortcut.
BUILT-IN SYSADMIN TOOLKIT
Quick diagnostics without leaving the app: Ping, Traceroute, DNS Lookup with propagation check, Whois, network scanner, Certificate Checker, Postmaster for SMTP and DMARC audits, HTTP Forge for crafted requests, Hex Viewer, Baker for data transformations, Code Forge for QR codes, Subnet Calculator, Cron generator, Password Generator and end-to-end encrypted Secret Share. The mashREPL local shell (ls, grep, curl, ping, tar and more) works even without internet access.
PRIVACY. PERIOD.
No account. No analytics. No ads. Your connections stay on your device, and iCloud sync only runs when you turn it on.
WHY WEBSSH?
Most SSH clients are either too basic or too bloated. WebSSH hits the sweet spot: professional-grade features, a clean mobile-first interface, and rock-solid reliability — every on-device feature unlocked with a single one-time PRO purchase, yours for life on every device.
One app. Every protocol. Zero compromises.
Download WebSSH and keep your servers close at hand, no matter where you are.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00016623:ios.description:
Meow-meow-meow!
Kid-E-Cats invite you on an exciting sea adventure!
Do you want to go and search for ancient treasures?
Lots of challenges await you on your way! Are you ready? Let's set off!
Fantastic journey with the cats on a big ship is waiting for you!
Pick your ship:
The Pirate Ship for the bravest!
The Sweet Ship for the ones with a sweet tooth!
The Coast Guard Ship in case order is your first priority!
Grandpa Cat found a real map, which shows where a treasure chest is hidden.
But the way to the treasure won't be easy, first of all you'll have to get to the island.
On the way you will deal with real icebergs, strong wind and even a storm ...
But the real sailors never give up, so neither shall we!
Cookie, Candy and Pudding have prepared interesting mini-games for real travelers!
- "Underwater treasure": dive under the water and find all the gold coins on the bottom of the ocean!
- "Diving": find all the fish! Be very attentive, they can hide anywhere!
- "Seashells collector": collect the most beautiful seashells with Candy!
- "Whale's photo": take pictures of the whale before he swims away!
- "Sea Shower": the whale has got dirty, wash the sea-mud off him!
- "Save the dinner": keep the birds away, they shouldn't eat the kittens' dinner!
- "Sea fishing": catch as many fish as possible!
The cats are getting really close! You only need to find the island now and run to grab the treasure!
So the treasure from the chest is... 
Oh no, you will have to find it out yourself!
Well, let's get going, ship casts off now!

bluejetty:00046646:android.description:
Sticker Trade revolutionizes the way you exchange stickers in Monopoly GO! by providing a seamless, fun, and efficient experience. Automatically sync all your stickers, eliminating the need for manual updates.
--- Key Features ---
• Automatic Sticker Sync: Automatically sync all your stickers and effortlessly keep your sticker collection up to date.
• Swipe to Exchange: Find trade partners quickly by swiping right to accept or left to decline trade proposals. No more tedious searching for trades.
• Complete Albums Automatically: Watch your album fill up with new stickers as trades are accepted, all without any manual effort on your part.
• Engaging Minigames: Stay entertained while waiting for trades with exciting minigames. Roll dice, move around the game board, collect tickets, and win more stickers.
• Increase Exchange Chances: The longer you stay in the app, the higher your chances of receiving trade proposals. Keep playing and watch your sticker collection grow!

• Stay Connected: Keep your Monopoly GO album updated automatically.
• Earn More Stickers: Enjoy minigames and earn additional stickers while you wait for trades.
• User-Friendly Design: Our app is designed for ease of use, making it accessible for all ages.
Join the Sticker Trade community today and complete your Monopoly GO! sticker album faster than ever before. Whether you're a casual player or a dedicated collector, Sticker Trade is the ultimate tool to enhance your sticker trading experience.
Download Sticker Trade now and start trading with players worldwide!
