bluejetty:00027787:ios.description:
15 phút nghe sách mỗi ngày để phát triển bản thân và sự nghiệp. Fonos, kho sách nói best-seller lớn nhất Việt Nam, với hàng nghìn sách nói, ebook, tóm tắt sách, podcast, thiền và truyện ngủ.
Biến thời gian di chuyển, tập thể dục hay nghỉ trưa thành cơ hội học hỏi. Chỉ cần 15 phút mỗi ngày.
SÁCH NÓI BEST-SELLER & ĐỘC QUYỀN
Hàng nghìn sách nói được thu âm chuyên nghiệp bởi đội ngũ voice talent tại studio của Fonos, mang đến trải nghiệm nghe chân thực và sống động.
Nghe nhiều nhất trên Fonos: Tâm Lý Học Về Tiền, Đắc Nhân Tâm, Sapiens, Tư Duy Nhanh Và Chậm, Dạy Con Làm Giàu, Tam Quốc Diễn Nghĩa, Hoàng Tử Bé, Doraemon.
Từ các tác giả hàng đầu: Thích Nhất Hạnh, Yuval Noah Harari, Fredrik Backman, Phan Văn Trường, Giản Tư Trung, Đặng Hoàng Giang, Xuân Phượng.
Fonos hợp tác cùng các nhà xuất bản uy tín nhất Việt Nam: NXB Trẻ, Nhã Nam, Alphabooks, Thái Hà, First News. 100% nội dung có bản quyền.
Sách nói kinh doanh, phát triển bản thân, lịch sử, văn học, khoa học và nhiều thể loại khác.
EBOOK
Đọc sách điện tử ngay trên Fonos. Kết hợp nghe sách nói và đọc ebook trong cùng một ứng dụng.
TÓM TẮT SÁCH
Nắm ý chính của sách hay trong 15 phút. Phù hợp cho người bận rộn muốn đọc nhiều hơn.
PODCAST & NỘI DUNG ĐỘC QUYỀN
Podcast về kinh doanh, phát triển bản thân, lịch sử và văn hóa. Cùng nội dung độc quyền: thiền, truyện nói thiếu nhi, truyện ngủ và nhạc chủ đề.
ĐƯỢC TIN DÙNG BỞI HÀNG TRIỆU NGƯỜI VIỆT
- 3.500.000+ lượt tải
- 35.000+ đánh giá, 4.7 sao trung bình
- Ứng dụng nổi bật của Apple 2024
- Được Forbes Vietnam, Vietcetera, CafeF giới thiệu
TÍNH NĂNG NỔI BẬT
- Nghe offline: tải sách về nghe không cần mạng
- Tốc độ nghe linh hoạt: 0.5x đến 2x
- Hẹn giờ tắt: nghe truyện trước khi ngủ
- CarPlay: nghe sách khi lái xe
- Đồng bộ: tiếp tục nghe trên mọi thiết bị
- Chương 1 miễn phí: thử nghe trước khi đăng ký
GÓI ĐĂNG KÝ
Fonos cung cấp nhiều gói phù hợp nhu cầu, từ gói Lite cho người mới bắt đầu đến gói Premium với toàn bộ nội dung: sách nói, tóm tắt sách, podcast, ebook và thiền.
Tải Fonos ngay để bắt đầu nghe sách mỗi ngày.
Thanh toán sẽ được tính vào tài khoản Apple ID khi xác nhận mua. Gói đăng ký tự động gia hạn trừ khi được tắt ít nhất 24 giờ trước khi kết thúc kỳ hiện tại. Quản lý hoặc hủy đăng ký trong Cài đặt > Apple ID > Đăng ký.
Điều khoản sử dụng: https://fonos.vn/terms
Chính sách bảo mật: https://fonos.vn/privacy

bluejetty:00040604:ios.description:
Traveling.com – Book Bus, Train, Ferry & Flight Tickets
Formerly GetByBus, Traveling.com is the all-in-one transport app for booking bus tickets, train tickets, ferry tickets, flight tickets, plane tickets and airport transfers across Croatia, the Balkans, Europe, Asia and 70+ countries worldwide. Compare trusted carriers, routes, departure times and ticket prices, discover travel deals and travel discounts, save money with cheap tickets, cheap bus and cheap train options, and enjoy secure online booking with instant confirmation.
Planning European travel, last minute travel or a multi-country trip? Book transportation online and manage every journey from one easy transport app.
BOOK BUS, TRAIN, FERRY & FLIGHT TICKETS
Search, compare and book transport in one convenient travel app.
- Bus travel across Europe, the Balkans and Southeast Asia
- Train travel for regional and international rail
- Ferry tickets across Croatian islands and the Adriatic
- Airport transfers and shared minivans
- Flight and plane tickets for longer journeys
PLAN EVERY TRIP – JOURNEY PLANNER & ITINERARY MANAGER
Our journey planner lets you build a trip itinerary, compare transportation options, organise your travel itinerary and manage bookings — all in one place.
Instantly access:
- Departure schedules and live availability
- Ticket prices and route details
- Carrier information and onboard amenities
- Traveler reviews and ratings
- Boarding information and travel updates
- Customer support before, during and after your trip
Everything you need for seamless travel is available in one easy booking app.
CROATIA, THE BALKANS & EUROPE
Popular routes include Zadar to Zagreb, Split to Zadar, Split to Zagreb, Sibenik to Zagreb, Rijeka to Zagreb, Zagreb to Plitvice Lakes, Zagreb to Dubrovnik, Dubrovnik to Split, Split to Makarska, Dubrovnik to Kotor, Dubrovnik to Mostar, Kotor to Budva, Sarajevo to Mostar, Sarajevo to Belgrade, Sarajevo to Zagreb, Mostar to Kotor, Split to Hvar, Metkovic to Zagreb, Tivat to Kotor, Ljubljana to Zagreb, Novi Sad to Belgrade, Tirana to Podgorica, Kotor to Podgorica, Pattaya to Suvarnabhumi Airport, Bangkok to Pattaya, Chiang Mai to Bangkok, Budapest to Vienna, Skopje to Prishtina and Sofia to Skopje.
Travel across Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Serbia, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Albania, Slovenia, Italy, Germany, Austria, France, Spain, the United Kingdom, Southeast Asia and beyond.
COMPARE TRUSTED CARRIERS
Compare schedules, transparent ticket prices, travel duration and onboard amenities before you book.
- FlixBus, Megabus and National Express
- Alsa, Avanza, Sena, Autostradale and BlaBlaCar Bus
- Jadrolinija, TP Line and Krilo
- Arriva, Centrotrans and Nomago
- Lomprayah, Thai Railway and GreenBus
MANAGE BOOKINGS & TRAVEL ACTIVITIES
Manage every booking with ease.
- Manage bookings anytime
- Change bookings or cancel tickets
- Download tickets and travel vouchers
- View upcoming trips
- Multi-transport booking for every journey
MOBILE TICKETS
Download tickets directly to your phone and board using QR codes whenever available.
EXCLUSIVE TRAVEL DEALS
Unlock app-exclusive travel deals, travel discounts and affordable asia travel, europe travel and last minute travel options.
CUSTOMER SUPPORT 24/7
Our customer support team is available before, during and after your journey.
WHY TRAVELERS CHOOSE TRAVELING.COM
- 200,000+ departures across 70+ countries
- One-stop transport app for bus travel, train travel, ferries and flights
- Journey planner and trip planner in one app
- Secure online booking with instant confirmation
- Easy booking, ticket management and travel activities
- Mobile tickets and downloadable travel vouchers
- Book transportation across multiple countries online
- Travel deals and affordable travel options
Download Traveling.com today with more routes, carriers and countries than ever.

Build your entire trip visually: add cities, stops and destinations across countries and continents. Change a stop and your whole route adjusts instantly.

AI TRAVEL PLANNER (PRO)

• Edit, adjust and make it completely your own

• Buy and activate directly in the app
• Works alongside your existing number
SMART PACKING LIST
Never forget what to pack again. Build smart packing lists tailored to your destination and trip length, and check everything off before you leave.
• Customizable packing lists per trip
• Check off items as you pack
• Never leave home without the essentials

See every country you've visited on your personal world map. Track your travel stats and watch your map grow with every new adventure.
• Pin every country you've visited
• Track your travel statistics
• See your world grow with every trip
WORKS OFFLINE
Your entire trip (routes, itinerary, bookings and maps) available offline. No wifi needed, anywhere in the world.
Download free and start planning your next adventure today.

bluejetty:00021960:ios.description:
Turn your old, blurry, black and white photos into high resolution, enhanced and colorized using the AI photo enhancer with one tap.
Pholorize is an AI photo colorizer app that colorize black and white pics automatically with its power from artificial intelligence. Pholorize mostly used to enhance and colorize old photo albums by more than 10000+ users and is recognized as one of the most known image colorizer apps. It has the capability to both enhance and colorize photos both in single and batch mode. So, you can basically scan an old photo album and add color to each photo instantly.
With this professional photo enhancer, you can easily enhance photo quality, unblur & sharpen images, and restore old photos to crystal-clear HD.
KEY FEATURES
Colorize and Restore Old Pictures
Add vibrant colors to any photo with single and batch photos modes. Colorize your old b & w family photos and memories and revive them again. With image restoration tool, first step is to enhance the photo quality by upscale the photo resolution, the second step is to remove the artifacts and finally the, AI will colorize the photo. By completing all three steps, you will restore old photos.
Improve Photo Resolution
Increase and upscale your pictures into HD photos without losing any detail. 
Enhance Photo Quality
You can easily use ai photo enhancer by only selecting your photos with one
 tap. The core of the enhancer relies on the powerful AI Enhancer technology the advantage of such technology brings face details and quality of photos in seconds.
Sharpen Details
Sharp and vibrant photos always look better compared to old photos. Pholorize makes it possible to edit and sharpen photos for also enhanced and colorized photos. You can easily adjust sharpen and vibrant settings.
Color Filters
Different type of prebuilt color filters make it easier to enhance both the colors of the photo and the picture itself. You can use this feature as a post-process tool after colorization.
Color Curves
Colorization process can be improved with the color curves. You can edit Red, Green, Blue and RGB channels seperately, it will generate better photos based on the quality of colors.
ADJUSTMENTS
With adjustments, you can edit all of the following list;
- Brightness - Contrast
- Saturation - Highlights - Shadows
- Tint
- Sharpness
Batch Colorization
What if you have an old photo album with lots of beautiful memories and photos, your heritage from back ? It is super easy with Pholorize, just select each captured image from your albums and that’s it! In a few seconds, you will find the beautiful memories back with it’s colorized version. It is pretty cool to see the old photos in AI improved quality.
UNLIMITED ACCESS TO ALL FEATURES

– Subscriptions are billed automatically at the rate depending on the selected subscription plan.

FOR FANS
- Easily acces
bluejetty:00016828:ios.description:
MyRacePass (MRP) gives you real-time access to lineups, results and information from thousands of race tracks. Follow your favorite tracks and series for quick access and stay up to date with all the racing action!
FOR FANS
- Easily access race information, lineups, results, and live timing.
- Follow point standings from your favorite tracks and series.
- View upcoming events to plan your next outing.
- Get the latest event updates rain outs.
- Access race by race point breakdowns for thousands of drivers.
- Access thousands of news articles from all genres of racing.
- Join Fantasy Racing and make your picks for hundreds of events.
- Listen to audio straight from the Announcers!
FOR PROMOTERS
- Sell more tickets for your events online and scan users into the gate.
- Publish schedules and point standings for maximum distribution.
- Promote your organization with on-demand apparel sales.
- Publish news articles to keep your fans and drivers in the know.
- Run Fantasy Leaderboards to engage your fans all season long.
FOR DRIVERS
- Find your official results and lineups.
- Review race by race point breakdowns.
- Check into racing events by scanning your device.
- Update your profile to keep fans in the loop.
MRP BASIC
- With a MRP Basic subscription you gain access to live timing and previous lap times for all tracks using MRP Live for only $7.99/year across all devices you log into.
MRP PRO
- A MRP Pro subscription comes with all the features of MRP Basic AND full sanction points AND full race-by-race points breakdown for all drivers in points throughout the MyRacePass network for only $34.99/year across all devices you log into.
MRP ALL ACCESS
- A MRP All Access subscription comes with all the features of MRP Basic, MRP Pro AND unlimited Fantasy Racing for only $54.99/year across all devices you log into.
MRP ALL ACCESS (Monthly)
- A MRP All Access (Monthly) subscription comes with all the features of MRP Basic, MRP Pro and MRP All Access for only $5.99/month across all devices you log into.
MANAGE SUBSCRIPTIONS
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
- Subscriptions are valid on any device logged into with your account.
- Visit https://www.myracepass.com/terms for full Terms and Conditions.

bluejetty:00031598:ios.name: WKRG Weather
bluejetty:00031598:ios.summary: Never let the weather catch you by surprise again. The trusted weather experts at First Alert Weather deliver Mobile, Pensacola, and the Gulf Coast's most accurate hour-by-hour forecast for the next day and for the week ahead. Unlike other
bluejetty:00031598:ios.description:
Never let the weather catch you by surprise again. The trusted weather experts at First Alert Weather deliver Mobile, Pensacola, and the Gulf Coast's most accurate hour-by-hour forecast for the next day and for the week ahead. Unlike other weather apps, you'll get a local forecast that is customized for you. Download the WKRG Weather app for fast, accurate local and national weather at your fingertips. With its personal alert notifications, you'll know when significant weather is heading your way and when to take cover. And when you are traveling, use WKRG Weather to get real-time weather forecasts, interactive radar and current conditions for anywhere in the U.S. 
The WKRG Weather app utilizes the most advanced radar maps, weather and digital technology available. With its easy to use interactive radar, you can take control and see where the storm is now and where it is tracking. 
Then, set customized alerts to keep you and your family informed and safe. 
Features: 
- Live interactive radar with many layering options lets you track the storms around you 
- Alerts for severe weather via push notification and cue an audible alert 
- The most accurate hour-by-hour forecast for the next day and week ahead for Mobile, Pensacola, and the Gulf Coast 
- The latest video forecast from First Alert Weather 
- Current weather conditions for Mobile, Pensacola, and the Gulf Coast and anywhere in the United States 
- Share the weather conditions via text message, email, Facebook or Twitter 
- You can set multiple custom locations to track forecasts, alerts, radar, and more

bluejetty:00027775:ios.description:
The Securian Canada Health Portal app lets you access your benefits plan information wherever you are, whenever you want.
From the palm of your hand, you can:
• Submit a claim directly from your smartphone or tablet.
• Find a health provider near you
• Check whether a health service or item is covered under your plan, and how much will be covered.
• Show your digital ID card (this is also your travel card if you have travel benefits) without logging into the app.
• Search your claims history and get the real time status of recently submitted claims as well as details of previously processed claims.
• See instantly if you have alerts for any outstanding claim audits.

bluejetty:00034954:ios.description:
Welcome to Neopia!
Dive into a whimsical world full of beloved characters and enchanting adventures. In Neopets: Faerie Fragments, you’ll embark on a quest to rebuild Faerieland while aiding a lost Light Faerie in need.
Game Features:
Unique Stories and Adventures
Join the journey to uncover forgotten memories and tackle exciting challenges. Discover the myriad tales Neopia has to offer as you explore new frontiers.
Classic Characters and Stories
Rebuild Faerieland with familiar Neopets themes, buildings, and items. Meet and interact with both beloved and new Neopian characters who will guide you on your quest.
Customize and Create
Express yourself by designing your Faerieland! Choose from a variety of buildings and furniture, allowing for endless combinations to personalize your Neopian adventure.
Engaging Match 3 Gameplay
Experience Match 3 puzzles like never before with hundreds of levels. These relaxed yet challenging puzzles will help you navigate Neopia and uncover hidden treasures.
The Faeries of Neopia need your help! Begin your adventure today in Neopets: Faerie Fragments and create the Faerieland of your dreams!

bluejetty:00014702:ios.description:
Live flight tracker for Seattle–Tacoma Airport (SEA). Free.
Arrivals, departures and flight status — on time, delayed, diverted, cancelled or landed. Gate numbers, baggage carousels and terminals, live. And keep the rest of your trip in the same app: boarding passes, where you parked, packing lists, tickets and bookings.
Perfect for travellers, frequent flyers, taxi drivers, airport staff and anyone meeting or seeing off passengers at Seattle–Tacoma Airport.
FLIGHTS
• Live arrivals and departures board, refreshed with one tap
• Search by flight number, airline, city, airport, terminal, gate or baggage belt
• Status at a glance: on time, delayed, diverted, cancelled, landed
• Codeshare flight matching
• Domestic and international filters
• Favourite flights
• Weather and local time at both ends of a flight, with a 3-day forecast
• Flights-per-hour report and status sharing
• Dark mode, 12- or 24-hour time, °C or °F
• Available in 61 languages
MY TRIP — YOUR TRAVEL ESSENTIALS
• Boarding passes: snap a photo, the barcode is read and shown full-screen at the gate
• My car: photos, a note and (optionally) the location of your spot, with walking directions back
• Checklists: packing lists to tick off, with a starter list
• Bag tags: tag number, airline and a photo of your bag
• Receipts: snap a receipt and the total is read for you
• Tickets: train, bus, ferry and event tickets, barcode shown large
• Bookings: hotel, car hire and insurance, with tap-to-call, maps and the confirmation attached
• Links and notes: save links from other apps and keep trip notes
• Trip dates with a countdown
• Backup to a file, with an optional password
Everything stays on your phone. No account needed.
PRO SUBSCRIPTION
• Add and edit everything in My trip
• Both ends of every flight: times, terminal, gate and baggage
• Flight details: taxi-out, air time, taxi-in and delays at each end
• Aircraft type and registration (tail number)
• Security and customs queue wait times (supported airports)
• PDF export of your trip and receipts
• No ads
Download now and always know exactly where every SEA flight stands.
—
This app is not an official airport app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Seattle–Tacoma Airport or any airline. For definitive flight times, please check the official airport or airline website. The developer accepts no liability for incidents resulting from use of the data shown.
Terms of Use (EULA)

bluejetty:00015383:ios.description:
Learn German is an easy to use mobile German phrasebook that will give visitors to Germany and those who are interested in learning German a good start in the language. 
Learn German is recorded using a native speaker and we have tried our best to be authentic in the pronunciation whilst ensuring it is easy to understand. Recommended app for tourists and business people visiting Germany. 
Features: 
• Universal app works on iPhone, iPod Touch, & iPad 
• Carefully translated list of essential phrases 
• 200+ common words and phrases included for FREE
• Upgrade and unlock all 800 phrases in 18 categories
• Audio recorded by native speakers
• Option to playback audio at slower speed
• No internet connection required
• Highlight important words with tips
• Store frequently used phrases in favourites
• Search by words inside the app
• No adverts or annoying popups 
CATEGORIES 
FREE Categories: 
* Greetings 
* General conversation 
* Numbers 
* Time and date 
* Directions and places 
* Transportation
* Emergency 
PRO Categories: 
* Accommodation 
* Eating out 
* Shopping 
* Colours 
* Towns and provinces 
* Countries 
* Tourist attractions 
* Family 
* Dating 
* Feeling sick 
* Tongue twisters 
• HOW TO RESTORE PURCHASES? 
Purchases are one-time and carry over between devices. To restore your purchases on a new device, tap on PRO badge on one of the locked categories, tap on the Restore Purchase button. Even if you forget to do this step and try to buy the app again, it will be restored for free. 
• WE READ EVERY E-MAIL. 
We're a small company, but we reply to every support request. Let us try to help at support@codegent.com and we will do our best to help in any way! 
THANKS FOR ALL THE SUPPORT IF YOU LIKE THE APP PLEASE LEAVE A REVIEW :-)
Privacy Policy: https://www.webronsoftware.co.uk/mobile-apps/learn-language/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00031740:ios.summary:

CHOOSE WHAT TO LEARN
Explore 252 lessons across 26 chapters, inclu
bluejetty:00031740:ios.description:
Start learning Hebrew with words and phrases you can read, listen to and practice at your own pace. English meanings and pronunciation guides help you explore the language.
CHOOSE WHAT TO LEARN
Explore 252 lessons across 26 chapters, including the alphabet, greetings, numbers, food, family, home, work, travel, transport, nature and more.
Start with the 22 Hebrew letters in the alphabet lesson, using audio and letter-name guides to become familiar with their forms and sounds.
Prefer a focused route? Choose from five mini courses: Starter Pack, Travel Basics, Food & Restaurant, Family & Home, and Health & Emergency. Each brings related lessons together around a useful topic.
LISTEN AND REVIEW
Choose between the Eden and David voice options for bundled recordings. Adjust playback speed and replay words or phrases as you study. Lesson text and bundled recordings can be used offline after installation. Purchases, ads and sending support messages require an internet connection.
PRACTICE WHAT YOU LEARN
Review with flashcards, answer multiple-choice and true-or-false questions, match words with their meanings, and type answers in writing exercises. Revisit words that need more practice and check your exercise results.
MAKE STUDYING PERSONAL
Save favorite words and phrases for quick review. Follow your learning progress, record daily check-ins and set study reminders with notification permission. Choose a theme and learning appearance that suits you.
KEEP A COPY OF YOUR PROGRESS
Use manual Backup & Restore to export your favorites, progress, exercise history and included preferences to a file. Import a compatible backup when you need it. Purchases and notification permissions are not transferred in the backup.
HELP IMPROVE THE CONTENT
Use the flag beside a word to prepare a report about its audio, translation or example. You can also open Feedback & Support in Settings or contact support@dugloapps.app.
ACCESS
Some learning content is available without a purchase. Access to all lessons and premium features requires a one-time purchase or subscription. See the in-app purchase screen for available plans and terms.
Privacy Policy: https://dugloapps.app/apps/learn-hebrew/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://dugloapps.app/apps/learn-hebrew/terms/

bluejetty:00047673:ios.description:
Farkle is the best game of such type.
This application enables you to play at any convenient time.
You can play individually without a risk of loosing your chips, practicing and gaining experience, developing new strategies of the game.
You can take your chances and put the chips in a kitty, and if you collect the necessary amount of points, you will get an increased bet. Depending on the type of the game you choose, you can double, triple or even quadruple the bet.
The program also enables playing with friends and strangers. Multiplayer will give an opportunity to feel the excitement of a real fight with real people.
In a tournament you have possibility to compete in real time with players around the world and to prove that you are the best Farkle player.
Game features:
• Simple registration: create a nickname or enter your name.
• At Facebook registration you can play on several devices, using your account. Data of your chips are synchronized on all devices you entered using profile. (Bonus is 10 000 chips).
• Online game with friends and strangers.
• Extra Dice: there are three types of Extra Dice:
- х2 - doubles the points for a round.
- 6 - adds 6 dice for a round.
- F – Unfarkle.
• Extra Dice can be used only once at a game. All three types of Extra Dice can be used in one round.
• Participating in weekly, monthly and general rating.
• Purchase of different dice and cups for a game. Be unique, play with non-standard dice and cups. Earn chips and choose the type of dice or cup which you like the most.
• Daily bonus: play every day and get chips and extra dice for a game.

bluejetty:00022035:ios.description:
South Korea's GPS navigation Get started right away
* Experience the completely new NAVER Map.
※ Are you traveling Korea? 
Don't miss the smart tips to use NAVER Map: https://naver.me/GfCSj5Ut
[Key features]
- Map Home Menu Tab
You can now conveniently use the Discover, Bookmark, Transit, Navigation, and MY tabs on the Home.
- Simplified search
Search locations, buses, subway, and more in a comprehensive search bar.
- Booking
Explore a new Booking tab, a space that brings together businesses and products available for booking on NAVER. From nearby restaurants, hair salons, amusement parks, one-day classes to even train tickets, you can find them all in one place on the booking tab.
- Discover
Helps you find new places nationwide and nearby. Enjoy real-time rankings, recommendation feeds, trending spots, bookmarked lists, and coupon offers.
- Navigation
Fast and accurate navigation with real-time traffic info and optimized usability for any driving condition.
- Vector map
360 degrees rotation-enabled vector map with 3D view of key landmarks via tilting.
- Transit
You can easily reach your destination by using transit directions for various modes of transportation, real-time departure and arrival times, and notifications for when to get on/off.
- Street view
Seamless street and aerial views provided for location search and route planning.
- Bookmark
Easily save your best restaurants and must-visit tourist spots on NAVER Map and share them with others.
- MY
View all your maps, reviews, and bookings in one place and write reviews with ease.
- Instant search
View useful info about your query, such as opening/closing times for supermarkets while you search.
- Language
Korean/English/Japanese/Chinese maps and English navigation provided.
*Requires iOS 16.0 or later
*Find out more tips on how to use NAVER Map
- NAVER Map customer service: http://naver.me/GYywEiT4
- NAVER Map blog: https://blog.naver.com/naver_map

- Tel: 1588-3820
- Address: 95, Jeongjail-ro, Bundang-gu, Seongnam-si, Gyeonggi-do, Republic of Korea

- Location: Used to show your location on the map so you can get directions and use navigation.
- Microphone: Used for voice search and Clova voice commands.
- Camera: Used for suggesting edits to place information, verifying MY Place receipts, providing AR directions, scanning QR codes, and verifying passports.
- Contacts: Used to make calls with Clova voice commands and to save phone numbers from place search results.
- Photos: Used to select photos for suggesting edits to place information and writing MY Place reviews.
- Motion & Fitness: Used to detect steps for AR directions and walking directions.
- Notifications: Used to send important notices, events, and promotional information.
- Allow Tracking: Used to deliver content and ads that match your interests and to limit inappropriate ads.

bluejetty:00021348:ios.description:
PhotoLab is designed to transform your ordinary selfies into extraordinary AI-generated photos. It has a user-friendly interface and a unlimited range of artistic effects. The app caters to various needs and moods, offering everything from professional-looking images for your CV to fun avatars to share with your friends.
Simple Creation Process:
* Select Your Effect: Begin by exploring and selecting from the wide range of available effects. Whether it's for a professional look or a playful design, there's an effect for every mood. PhotoLab is equipped with an array of artistic filters. You can choose from timeless yearbook effects, vibrant anime styles, festive Christmas themes, and even adventurous racing driver looks.
* Upload Your Photo: Simply upload a selfie or any photo from your gallery. PhotoLab's advanced AI technology is designed to work effectively with just a single image.
* Choose the Format: Decide on the format you want for your avatar – be it square for profile pictures or a standard size for sharing.
* Quick Transformation: In just a few seconds, PhotoLab's powerful AI processes your photo, applying the chosen effect with precision and creativity.
* View the Results: Instantly view different variations of your avatar, all reflecting the chosen effect in unique ways.
* Easy Export and Sharing: Once you find the perfect avatar, you can effortlessly save it to your camera roll or export it directly to your favorite social networks.
PhotoLab is not just an app – it's a gateway to exploring your identity in the digital world. It combines simplicity, creativity, and speed, offering a unique way to express yourself through AI-powered avatars. Whether for professional use or social fun, PhotoLab is your go-to app for avatar creation on iOS.

• You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal from your Account Settings after the purchase
• Your subscription will renew automatically, unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• The cost of renewal will be charged to your account in the 24 hours prior to the end of the current period
• When canceling a subscription, your subscription will stay active until the end of the period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but the current subscription will not be refunded
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription

bluejetty:00030416:ios.name: Sport Clips Haircuts Check-In
bluejetty:00030416:ios.summary: The Sport Clips app allows you to see wait times at stores near you, select your store and Stylist, and join the lineup from anywhere. No more wasting time in the lobby. Stay connected while you wait for your haircut so you can go on with y
bluejetty:00030416:ios.description:
The Sport Clips app allows you to see wait times at stores near you, select your store and Stylist, and join the lineup from anywhere. No more wasting time in the lobby. Stay connected while you wait for your haircut so you can go on with your day. The app is now available in the U.S. and Canada.
Features
- Join the lineup: No more guessing. Compare wait times at different Sport Clips stores near you and get in line while you go about your day. 
- Choose your Stylist: Did you love your last precision haircut? Default to the first available stylist or see who is working and select a specific Stylist for your next haircut.
- Add a guest: We’ll take care of the whole crew—add you and up to four guests to the lineup, or just your guests.
- See what’s happening from anywhere: With our Haircut Tracker, you can see where you are in the lineup, how many people are ahead of you, and each Stylist’s status at any moment. 
- Receive live updates: We’ll let you know when to head to the store, when you’re up next, and if anything changes about your visit. We recommend enabling push notifications and location settings for the best experience.
- Receive promos & account notifications: Through the Sport Clips app, you can set your account preferences to opt in to the notifications you want, and specify how you want to receive them.
- Save your favorites: Love your MVP haircut experience? Save your favorite store and Stylist to your preferences for next time.
How to use
First, download the Sport Clips app and create an account or log in. Don’t forget to enable your location settings to see stores in your area. Next, select the store you’d like—you can choose based on past visits, your location, or the shortest wait—and tap “Join the lineup.” Then, choose which Stylist you’d like for your visit, and for any guests who may be with you. Tap “Join the lineup” once more and you’re in!
What happens next?
Once you join the lineup, our Haircut Tracker will give you a live play-by-play of how long your estimated wait time is, how many people are ahead of you, and your Stylist’s status. This way, you can plan your travel time and go on with your day while you wait for your haircut. Enable location services so we can seamlessly check you in when you arrive with our Geofencing check-in, making your entry to the store efficient and contactless. You can also let a Stylist know you’ve arrived instead, or enter your phone number in the kiosk in the store to check in. We’ll let you know when you’re up next! If you lose your spot in the lineup, simply tap ‘Join the lineup’ again and check in once you arrive at the store.

bluejetty:00025512:android.summary: Solitaire Daily Break is an engaging and interactive classic solitaire game. Play the classic card game you know and love completely for free- even offline! Relax and play endless levels of free classic solitaire. Gather solitaire jigsaw pu
bluejetty:00025512:android.description:
Solitaire Daily Break is an engaging and interactive classic solitaire game. Play the classic card game you know and love completely for free- even offline! Relax and play endless levels of free classic solitaire. Gather solitaire jigsaw puzzle pieces while you play and unlock beautiful jigsaw paintings! The goal of the game is to move all the cards from the Tableau to the Foundation from Aces to Kings in the same suit.
Play solitaire games, gather jigsaw pieces, complete puzzles and earn customized backgrounds, card fronts and backs- even when you play offline.
Play free solitaire with the most stunning background and card themes you’ve ever seen! Enhance the experience even when you play in offline mode with fan favorite themes like anime, outer space, ancient Egypt and many more!
Looking for something fun to do in your spare time? Step into the Solitaire jigsaw puzzle kingdom and play a new solitaire card game! Download Solitaire Daily Break and play solitaire free even when you’re offline. Also known as the patience game, classic solitaire involves strategy, skill, and a little luck.
Keep your mind sharp by solving free solitaire games and Solitaire jigsaw puzzle games. This classic solitaire card game will help you keep your brain active during your downtime. Play these free basic solitaire card games and enjoy the best puzzle card games anytime, anywhere!
 CLASSIC SOLITAIRE FEATURES:
♠️ Completely free solitaire!
♥️ Classic scoring system. Keep track of your solitaire jigsaw puzzle game performance with statistics on your current match and your all-time best score
 ♦️ 3-card draw: 3-card settings turn the game into an even more challenging and thrilling experience. Make the most out of this solitaire puzzle game and triple the fun!
 ♠️ Autocomplete: Quickly finish a solved game
 ♥️ Boosters: Not sure what your next move should be? Use the ‘hint’ booster to make things easier. Regret your last move? No problem. Use the ‘Undo’ booster to take it back
 ♦️ Stunning animations and sounds plus, a neat and responsive design with haptic feedback!
 ♣️ New player friendly: Use our tutorial for beginners and you’ll be completing levels in no time!
So, sit back, unwind, and play Solitare Daily Break- the most engrossing solitare card game online and even offline!

bluejetty:00014840:ios.name: UpKeep Work Order Maintenance
bluejetty:00014840:ios.summary:
UpKeep is the CMMS platform trusted by 4,000+ companies, including McDonald's, Caterpillar, and Chevron, to manage maintenance, safety, and reliability. Teams on UpKeep cut downtime by 26% and extend asset life by 11%.
Create a work order
bluejetty:00014840:ios.description:
UpKeep is the CMMS platform trusted by 4,000+ companies, including McDonald's, Caterpillar, and Chevron, to manage maintenance, safety, and reliability. Teams on UpKeep cut downtime by 26% and extend asset life by 11%.
Create a work order by voice, photo, or text. Check an asset's full history from the plant floor. Close out a PM with the checklist already built. UpKeep is designed for technicians first, so the work gets logged where it happens, not at a desk hours later.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
WORK ORDERS: Create, assign, and track work from your phone. Voice notes become work orders, and every change is logged until the job is done.
PREVENTIVE MAINTENANCE: Schedule by time, usage, or condition. Checklists and reminders make sure nothing gets skipped.
ASSET MANAGEMENT: Full history, parts, and costs for every asset at every site, in your pocket.
AI THAT WORKS FOR YOU: Nova generates work orders, builds checklists, and flags issues before you ask. Studio lets you build custom workflows around your business logic, no code needed.
IIOT SENSORS: UpKeep Edge tracks temperature, vibration, and runtime, and opens a work order the moment a reading drifts.
SAFETY & COMPLIANCE: Safety steps and sign-offs live in the work order, so compliance records build as the work gets done.
TRAINING: UpKeep Learn turns your SOPs into courses, so new techs get up to speed faster.
WHO IT'S FOR
Maintenance and operations teams in manufacturing, facilities, food & beverage, retail, transportation, and healthcare, from a single site to hundreds.
Move from reactive repairs to planned, predictable work. Download UpKeep and take your maintenance operation mobile.

bluejetty:00013673:ios.description:
The Arabic Bible is the translation of the Holy Scriptures into the Arabic language, created to help Arabic-speaking people understand the Christian faith in their native language. Arabic Bible translations date back centuries, preserving the meaning of the original scriptures.
Over the years, it has been revised several times to remain clear and meaningful for modern readers and younger generations. Today, the Arabic Bible continues to inspire and guide millions of Arabic-speaking people.

Daily Verse: Set reminders for daily Bible verse notifications.
MY LIBRARY: Access your highlights, notes, and bookmarked verses.
Old & New Testaments: Read both Testaments in one app.
Verse Editor: Create beautiful verse posts with backgrounds and share them.
Nearby Churches: Find churches near your location.
Books: Explore a collection of Christian eBooks.
Wallpapers: Browse beautiful and inspiring wallpapers.
Videos: Watch videos on Jesus, Hope, Wisdom, Motivation, Gratitude, Healing, and more.
Festive Calendar: Explore Christian festivals and feast days.

Bible Stories: Read timeless and inspiring Bible stories for all ages.
Bible FAQ: Find quick answers to common Bible and Christian life questions.
Verse Comments: Share thoughts and engage in community discussions.

bluejetty:00021913:ios.name: Zenkit To Do
bluejetty:00021913:ios.summary:
Zenkit To Do is a super-simple task management app to help you work productively and collaborate with anyone.
It lets you organize your tasks, shopping lists, meetings, events, trips, ideas, notes, places, and whatever else is important to
bluejetty:00021913:ios.description:
Zenkit To Do is a super-simple task management app to help you work productively and collaborate with anyone.
It lets you organize your tasks, shopping lists, meetings, events, trips, ideas, notes, places, and whatever else is important to you.
You can create lists and share tasks with your team members, family, and friends.
To Do synchronizes everything between all your devices so you can access your lists wherever you are, even offline.
----------
Zenkit To Do is part of the Zenkit product family. Zenkit has won several awards and is celebrated in Lifehacker, TechCrunch, CNET, and The Next Web, to name but a few.
----------
Organize
• Create any lists you need and use them on your phone, tablet, and computer simultaneously.
• Add images, PDFs, presentations, photos, links, and other documents to your tasks.
• Set reminders so you never miss an important date.
• Use folders to help you organize your lists.
Collaboration
• Share lists with team members, friends, and family.
• Or share whole folders to make sure everyone has the lists they need.
• Comment on tasks to keep your chats in context.
• @mention other users to contact them directly.
• Assign tasks so everyone knows what they need to do.
• See everything you need to work on in the “Assigned to Me” list.
Use Anywhere, Safely
• All content is automatically synchronized across all of your devices.
• All content is available offline, so you can continue working without the internet.
• Your content belongs to YOU.
• Data privacy and protection is central to us.
• 2FA login protects your account.
• Our servers are located in Germany.
The Zenkit Universe
• To Do works seamlessly with the original Zenkit app and other Zenkit products. This means you can also access your tasks on a Kanban board, Gantt chart, or with a mind map. Stay tuned!
• Additional custom fields and references to other objects such as customers etc. are possible through the Zenkit app.
Our privacy policy: https://zenkit.com/privacy/
Our terms of use: https://zenkit.com/terms/
For more information, go to https://zenkit.com/todo/

bluejetty:00037929:ios.description:
Paintwork is a simple and powerful software for handwritten notebooks, diaries, and hand drawn images.
It includes functions such as: brush list (hundreds of brush effects, customizable brush thickness, color, transparency, dynamic strength weights, etc.), eraser list (each brush effect can be used as an eraser), Vector graphics tools (including lasso, vector eraser, vector pen, annotation pen, highlighter, wavy pen, double line pen, text box, illustration, dashed line, horizontal and vertical dashed line, curve, closed shape, text pen, rectangle, ellipse, straight line, arrow, triangle, pentagram, polygon, etc.), and also include many related attribute settings, Color list (with a rich color palette and customizable manual configuration of commonly used colors), copy and cut the content of specified areas on the page, import images or materials, as well as a simple calculator, handwriting assistance, and photo scanning of document files. Unlimited writing, ruler, recognition of text, printing of text, filling, and the ability to export PDF files or images. Supports custom background functionality, custom canvas paper, and more.
It can be used to write for classroom or book learning notes, handwritten notes for work meetings, hand drawn mind maps, hand drawn account creation, hand made account book making, writing diaries, recording life thoughts, calligraphy practice, handwritten brush and pencil characters, hand drawn artistic characters, and so on. Supports Apple pencil. Can export images or PDFs.
If you have any comments or feedback, please feel free to contact us. Contact email: pw_team@163.com
If you like our application, please give us a good review. Thank you.

bluejetty:00026384:ios.description:
WaterDo is an aesthetically pleasing to-do app created by the team of Forest: Stay Focused, the #1 productivity app with over 40 million users. It helps you stay on track and organise your daily list of jobs in the most intriguing way imaginable!
You cannot avoid the tedious chores in life, but you can choose to make them fun! In addition to the soothing interface and fun mechanism, WaterDo is equipped with reminders and a calendar that make your life more efficient! Here, your schedule becomes a list of bouncy water balls. Pop them after you've completed your tasks and enjoy the wonderful sensation of watching them burst.
*Warning! The burst is extremely satisfying. Enjoy yourself!
What WaterDo has to offer:
- Visualise your to-do list by turning tasks into water balls.
- Add notes anytime, anywhere as things pop into your head.
- Use the 'Water ball of the day' feature to prioritise the most important task.
- Daily task review helps you go over your progress and take control of your life.
- Schedule your tasks with ease, be the master of time management.
- Set reminders, unwind and snooze. We've got y'all procrastinators covered!
- Complete tasks to unlock treasure chests. Your dedication deserves to be rewarded.
- Explore various theme islands and begin your magical journey!
SUBSCRIPTIONS & BILLING
WaterDo offers free features for use, and welcomes you to experience the premium version through a free trial.
After the trial period, if offered, your subscription automatically renews unless turned off 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your Apple account settings. Removing the app doesn't cancel the subscription.
Gamification brings motivation and motivation boosts productivity. 
Download WaterDo right now and turn boring to-dos into motivations!
Terms of Service: https://waterdo.seekrtech.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://waterdo.seekrtech.com/privacy/
